htmlDescription.htmlText:
This charming house that can accommodate 5 people is located in the "BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS" Residence.
Easy access, the setting is peaceful, pleasant and secured by surveillance cameras.

The space
Easy access, the setting is peaceful, pleasant and secured by surveillance cameras.
Located 80 meters from the main road not far from the Bonamoussadi public school and the "Yoro Joss" crossroads, this 70 m2 air-conditioned house has a spacious backyard with swimming pool and boukarou, a carefully furnished living room and dining room, 2 bedrooms with closets and large double beds, a shower room with hot water, a separate toilet with a hand shower for intimate toiletries, a fully equipped kitchen with all necessary equipment, a borehole (water 24/7), Wi-Fi, a generator (which takes over by providing electricity as soon as there is a power outage), and a cleaning service twice a week.
This property has a ONEO prepaid meter that can be recharged by the customer.
Close to all amenities, "Bonamoussadi Gardens" is located near the large Bonamoussadi market, banks, restaurants, gas stations, public hospital, parks, leisure centers, snack bars, nightclubs, supermarkets: Carrefour market, Mahima, Super U, Kado and Santa Lucia.
The Santa Lucia SUPERMARKET OPEN 24/7 has a FAST FOOD section where you can enjoy hot dishes also 24/7.
The PARCOURS VITA, located 10 minutes from the BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS residence, is the ideal place to practice SPORT, FITNESS in the OPEN AIR. The activities are diverse: from soccer to basketball to dance and pedal boats. There are sports coaches, a children's playground, a lake with the possibility of swimming, and many green spaces. Access to this 2.6 km long ecological course is free.
The "BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS" residence is located 12 km from Douala International Airport and the Grand Mall (large shopping mall).
A security deposit of 150 euros will be requested upon arrival after the inventory and returned on the day of departure.
We guarantee you a quality stay.

Other things to note
electricity costs are the responsibility of the guests. A prepaid meter is available to them to recharge the meter

Guest access
*Check-in & Key info*
*Self check-in:* Our security guard will open the gate for you, and the receptionist will check you in, help with your luggage, and show you around. Staff are on-site 24/7 on day/night shifts, so someone’s always available if you need anything.

*The details:*
- *Bed ready for you:* Rooms are made up with fresh sheets + spare sheets/towels 3 hours before arrival. Towels and soap provided in bathroom & kitchen.
- *In-room comforts:* Iron in the closet, spare bed sheet/towel on hand, queen-size beds for restful sleep.
- *Kitchen:* Fully furnished with pots, plates, spoons, knives, basins, gas stove + all cooking utensils. Feel free to cook your own meals.
- *Cleaning:* Rooms serviced twice a week by our dedicated cleaners to keep things fresh.

*House rules*
1. *Check-in time: anytime before 10PM | *Check-out time:* 11:00 AM
2. *Guests:* Registered guests only for security reasons
3. *Smoking:* Not allowed indoors
4. *Parties/events:* Not allowed - this is a quiet space for rest
5. *Extra services:* Cars for rent + in-house chef for breakfast/meals available on request

We’re here to make your stay smooth and stress-free. Message us anytime - the reception team has you covered.

Thank you. Lita Residence manager

Other things to note
*Pre-booking info for guests - “What guests should know”

*1. Check-in process*
Security guard opens the gate 24/7. Receptionist checks you in, helps with luggage, and shows you to your apartment Staff on day + night shift = someone always available.

*2. Room prep*
Your room is made up with fresh sheets + spare sheet/towel 3 hours before arrival. Iron in closet. Towels + soap provided in bathroom & kitchen.

*3. What’s included*
Queen-size beds, 24/7 Wi-Fi, hot water, backup generator + borehole water, CCTV, day/night guards. Kitchen fully furnished: pots, plates, spoons, knives, basins, gas stove + all utensils.

*4. Extras on request*
Cars for rent + in-house chef for breakfast/meals. Just message me on Airbnb app after booking.

*5. How to reach us*
Message through Airbnb. Reception is 24/7 once checked in.
Thank you, Manager Lita Residence

htmlDescription.htmlText:
BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS: HOUSE in RESIDENCE with SWIMMING POOL. WATER 24/7. WIFI.

The space
Cozy and peaceful maisonette in the "BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS" residence that can accommodate 4 people.
Easy access, the setting is pleasant and secured by surveillance cameras.
Located 80 meters from the main road, not far from the Bonamoussadi public school and the "Yoro Joss" crossroads.
This 50 m2 air-conditioned maisonette has a spacious backyard with swimming pool and boukarou, a borehole (water 24/7), Wi-Fi, a generator (which takes over by providing electricity as soon as there is a power cut), a carefully furnished living room with dining area, a kitchenette fully equipped with all necessary equipment, 2 bedrooms with large double beds, a shower room with hot water, toilet and hand shower for intimate toiletries, and a maid service twice a week.
This property has a ONEO prepaid meter that can be recharged by the customer.
Close to all amenities, it is located close to the large Bonamoussadi market, banks, restaurants, parks, leisure centers, snack bars, nightclubs, supermarkets: Carrefour Market, Super U, Kado, Mahima, Santa Lucia...
The Santa Lucia SUPERMARKET OPEN 24/7 has a FAST FOOD where you can also enjoy hot dishes 24/7.
The VITA COURSE, located 10 minutes from the BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS Residence, is the ideal place to practice SPORT, FITNESS in the OPEN AIR. Activities are diverse: from soccer to basketball to dance and pedal boats. There are sports coaches, a children's playground, a lake with the possibility of swimming, and many green spaces. Access to this 2.6 km long ecological TRAIL is free.
The "BONAMOUSSADI GARDENS" residence is located 12 km from Douala International Airport and the Grand Mall (large shopping mall).
A security deposit of 150 euros will be requested upon arrival after the inventory and returned on the day of departure.

We guarantee you a quality stay.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content: Nestled between the River Thames, Covent Garden and the West End, this neighbourhood puts the very best of Central London on your doorstep. Walk to Covent Garden, Soho, Trafalgar Square, the London Eye and world-famous theatres in minutes. Charing Cross and Embankment stations are less than a minute away, providing excellent transport links across London. Enjoy street performers, riverside walks, cafés, restaurants, pubs and cultural attractions all within easy walking distance.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
Most of London’s most famous attractions are within walking distance, including Covent Garden, Soho, Trafalgar Square, the London Eye and the South Bank. The West End’s world-renowned theatres are just 5 minutes away, with dozens of shows, musicals and performances on your doorstep.

Embankment Gardens and the River Thames are at the end of the street, while St James’s Park, Green Park and Hyde Park are all easily accessible. The area is highly walkable, with Santander Cycle hire points nearby and plenty of taxis available. Parking is limited and expensive in Central London, so public transport is recommended.

Getting around couldn’t be easier. Charing Cross and Embankment stations are less than a minute’s walk away, providing quick access across London via the Northern, Bakerloo, Circle and District lines, as well as National Rail services and Black taxis go constantly from the Strand which is 30 seconds walk.

Travel to and from London’s airports is simple and convenient:

- Heathrow Airport (LHR) – Approximately 18 miles (29 km), around 45–60 minutes by taxi, depending on traffic. Take the Elizabeth line to Paddington (around 28 minutes) and change for the Bakerloo line or a short taxi to Charing Cross. Heathrow Express reaches Paddington in just 15 minutes.

- Gatwick Airport (LGW) – Approximately 30 miles (48 km). The Gatwick Express reaches Victoria Station in around 30–32 minutes, with Charing Cross just one stop away on the Underground or a short taxi ride.

- London City Airport (LCY) – Approximately 9 miles (14 km), around 30–40 minutes by taxi. Alternatively, take the DLR to Bank and connect to the Northern line for Embankment or Charing Cross.

- Stansted Airport (STN) – Approximately 40 miles (64 km). The Stansted Express to Liverpool Street takes around 50 minutes, with direct Underground connections to Charing Cross.

- Luton Airport (LTN) – Approximately 35 miles (56 km). Regular trains from Luton Airport Parkway to Central London connect easily to Charing Cross via the Underground.

With direct rail links, Underground services and taxis available 24/7, the apartment offers excellent access for both international visitors and business travellers arriving from any of London’s major airports.

Located in one of West London's most sought-after residential neighbourhoods, you'll be surrounded by elegant streets, beautiful architecture and an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, pubs and independent boutiques.

The area offers easy access to the green open spaces of Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park, while nearby Notting Hill is famous for its colourful streets, vibrant atmosphere, charming cafés and the renowned Portobello Road Market.

For shopping enthusiasts, you'll also be within easy reach of the world-famous boutiques and department stores of Kensington and Knightsbridge.

Whether you're looking to explore London's iconic landmarks, enjoy local dining or simply relax in beautiful surroundings, this location offers the best of both worlds.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:

Notting Hill Gate Station (Central, Circle & District lines) – approximately a 7-minute walk.
High Street Kensington Station (Circle & District lines) – approximately a 10-minute walk.
Queensway Station (Central line) – around a 12-minute walk.

If you're arriving from Heathrow Airport, take the Elizabeth Line or Heathrow Express to Paddington Station, then continue by taxi (approximately 10 minutes) or by Underground for one stop before walking to the property.

From Gatwick Airport, take a direct train to London Victoria, then continue on the Circle or District line to a nearby station.

Several London bus routes operate nearby, providing convenient connections to Kensington, Notting Hill, Oxford Street, Victoria, Marble Arch and other central London destinations.

Taxis and ride-hailing services such as Uber are readily available throughout the area, and if you're arriving by car, there are several public car parks nearby (please note that on-street parking is restricted and subject to local regulations).

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Enjoy stylish Central London living in this modern two-bedroom flat in Bloomsbury, just a short walk from the British Museum. The bright space features two comfortable bedrooms, a cosy living area, and a fully equipped kitchen—ideal for relaxing stays.

Transport:
5-min walk to Euston (tube & train), Warren Street & Goodge Street
13-min to Tottenham Court Road
15-min to Russell Square.

Nearby:
5-min to University of London
11-min to the British Museum
16 mins by bus to Covent Garden.

The space
Relax and Unwind in the Living Room

After a day exploring London, relax in the inviting living area designed for comfort and ease. Soft lighting, tasteful décor, and a flat screen TV create the perfect setting for quiet evenings or a movie night.

Comfortable Double Bedrooms

Enjoy restful nights in two peaceful bedrooms, each featuring a comfortable double bed with quality linens. The rooms are thoughtfully styled to provide a calm and relaxing space to recharge after a busy day in the city.

Modern Kitchen

The kitchen offers everything you need for a convenient stay, ideal for preparing light meals, morning coffee, or a quick breakfast before heading out to explore.

Modern Bathroom

The apartment includes one bright and modern bathroom designed for comfort and convenience, featuring a walk in shower. Fresh towels and essential toiletries are provided for your stay.

Fast WiFi and Work Friendly Space

Stay connected with reliable high speed WiFi, perfect for remote work, video calls, or streaming your favourite shows after a day out in London.

Bloomsbury Neighbourhood

Located in the historic and highly desirable neighbourhood of Bloomsbury, the area is known for its charming garden squares, elegant architecture, and relaxed atmosphere while remaining in the heart of Central London. Guests can enjoy a mix of culture, dining, and shopping, all within walking distance. The world famous British Museum is just moments away, while the vibrant areas of Covent Garden and Soho are also nearby, offering theatres, restaurants, and entertainment.

Green spaces such as Russell Square provide a peaceful escape from the city, perfect for morning walks or relaxing afternoons.

Shops: Convenient options nearby including local supermarkets, convenience stores, and shopping along Tottenham Court Road and Oxford Street.

Dining: A great selection of cafés, bakeries, restaurants, and traditional pubs throughout Bloomsbury and nearby Covent Garden, perfect for relaxed brunches, casual dining, or evening drinks.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
West Coast Villa is planted between the Atlantic ocean and the mount Cameroon. This vacation villa is a true gem waiting to be discovered. Its beauty, security and serenity are matched by none in Limbe. It has 2 sitting rooms, 1 living room, 3 generously sized bedrooms, a dining area, and a large fully furnished kitchen. Its perimeter fence is mainly of spaced steel bars to ensure that you don’t miss the sea breeze. It has a terrace with a 180° view of the Atlantic

The space
Key Features

Picturesque Landscaping: Immerse yourself in a paradise with meticulously manicured gardens, roses, and a private terrace that will leave you breathless.

Elegant Architecture: This architectural masterpiece boasts timeless design and craftsmanship, with every detail carefully considered to create a mix of Europe, Asia, and Africa in one property.

Panoramic Views: Enjoy breath-taking sunsets and panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Limbe botanical garden, the Limbe Olympic Stadium, Mount Cameroon, and Malabo during night fall from your own private terrace.

Luxurious Bedrooms: Retreat to your spacious and sumptuous master suite, complete with a spa-like ensuite bathroom and a walk-in closet that dreams are made of.

Ample Parking: A patio to contain eight cars provides convenience and security for your vehicles and storage needs.

Your Opportunity Awaits
This is not just a house; it is a lifestyle. Whether you're seeking a serene retreat or an entertainer's paradise, this property offers the best of both worlds. Don't miss the chance to make this dream property your vacation home.

Guest access
Prime Location - Located at 100M from the main road that leads to Batoke, Bakingili and Idenau, you'll have easy access to shops.

Other things to note
Discover Limbe from the Comfort of West Coast Villa.

Perfectly situated in a prime location, West Coast Villa offers guests easy access to Limbe's most iconic attractions, making it the ideal base for relaxation, adventure, and cultural exploration.
Within just a 5–8-minute drive, you can get a complete conservation experience. You’ve got the Limbe Botanical Garden, Africa's oldest botanical garden, established in 1892, where lush tropical landscapes and rare plant species duel, and the Limbe Wildlife Centre, home to rescued gorillas, chimpanzees, monkeys, and other fascinating wildlife right next door.
If you are a history enthusiast you can take a scenic 30-minute drive to the historic Bimbia Slave Port, where the haunting ruins tell the powerful story of the transatlantic slave trade and preserve an important chapter of African history.
Just 8–10 minutes away stands the Alfred Saker Monument, honoring the British missionary whose vision and leadership played a significant role in the founding and early development of Limbe formerly called Victoria
If you are a beach lover, you are equally spoiled for choice. West Coast Villa is surrounded by some of Limbe's stunning volcanic black-sand beaches, including:
Wovia Beach – only 5–7 minutes' walk from the villa.
Down Beach – approximately 8–10 minutes' drive, renowned for its vibrant atmosphere, seafood, and ocean views.
Tsaben Beach – just 8–10 minutes' drive, a favorite destination for swimming and peaceful seaside relaxation.

Whether you're visiting for leisure, nature, history, or business, West Coast Villa places the very best of Limbe within easy reach while providing a comfortable, peaceful, and welcoming place to retreat to.

locationDescriptions.content: The Bijou neighborhood in Makepe, Douala, Cameroon, embodies a picturesque mix of urban life and local charm. Its bustling streets are lined with colorful shops, lively markets, and lively restaurants, offering an eclectic and vibrant experience. The architectural diversity of the residences reflects local history and culture. Bijou is also known for its warm community, creating a welcoming atmosphere for both residents and visitors, making this neighborhood a lively destination in the heart of Douala.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
Bijou Makepe is a pleasant and well-connected neighborhood, ideal for discovering Douala without stress. You can easily get around on foot to go to the bakery, supermarket or have a coffee in the area.

For slightly longer trips: City taxis run continuously and take you to neighborhoods such as Bonamoussadi, Akwa or Bali.

Yango, Bolt or EasyRide apps allow you to order a vehicle safely, at affordable rates.

From Bijou Makepe, you can easily reach downtown, restaurants and lively areas of Douala — while enjoying the calmness of the neighborhood.

Guest access

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
🖼️ Nearby Museums:

Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A): A world-renowned museum of art and design, housing over 2.8 million objects spanning 5,000 years of human creativity.

Natural History Museum: Famous for its stunning architecture and vast collections, including dinosaur fossils, minerals, and a giant blue whale model.

Science Museum: Features interactive exhibits on science, technology, and medicine, with highlights like the Apollo 10 command module and the Wonderlab gallery.

Design Museum: Dedicated to contemporary design, showcasing iconic objects and exhibitions on design history and innovation.

Leighton House Museum: The former home of Victorian artist Frederic Leighton, displaying a unique blend of art and architecture, including the stunning Arab Hall.


🍽️ Nearby Restaurants:

Within a short distance, you’ll find a variety of dining options to suit every palate. Experience Italian cuisine with classic pastas, pizzas, and Mediterranean flavors,French dishes featuring refined sauces and fresh pastries, Japanese specialties such as sushi and ramen, Indian cuisine with aromatic curries and tandoori dishes; Middle Eastern offerings with grilled meats, falafel, and fresh mezze, and Modern European restaurants presenting contemporary twists on seasonal European classics.


🛒 Nearby Grocery Stores:

Within the local area, there are several convenient grocery options. Waitrose & Partners offers high-quality products, including organic and specialty items. Sainsbury’s Local and Tesco Express provide everyday essentials, fresh produce, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals. Marks & Spencer Simply Food is known for premium ready meals, bakery items, and quality produce. For international and specialty ingredients, local stores such as Noor Supermarket and Green Valley offer Middle Eastern products, spices, and ready to eat dishes, making shopping for groceries simple and accessible.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
🚄 From Stansted Airport (STN):

Take the Stansted Express to Liverpool Street Station.

Transfer to the Central Line (westbound) to Notting Hill Gate, then change to the District or Circle Line (southbound) to South Kensington Station.

From South Kensington, the flat is a short walk.

✈️ From Heathrow Airport (LHR):

Take the Piccadilly Line (eastbound) directly to South Kensington Station.

Walk a few minutes to reach Courtfield Road.

✈️ From Gatwick Airport (LGW):

Take the Gatwick Express to Victoria Station.

Transfer to the District or Circle Line (westbound) to South Kensington Station.

Walk a few minutes to the flat.

🚉 From St Pancras International:

Take the Victoria Line southbound to Green Park, then transfer to the Piccadilly Line (westbound) to South Kensington Station.

Walk a short distance to Courtfield Road.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire property, ensuring a more comfortable and private stay. Enjoy the freedom to use all amenities, making yourself at home in your own space.

Early Check-In & Late Check-Out:
Please note that early check-in or late check-out may be available upon request for an additional fee, subject to availability. To arrange early check-in or late check-out, please contact us at least a day or two before your arrival so we can confirm if it's possible for your stay ☺️

Late Check-Out Without Notice Policy:

Lost Key Policy:
In the unfortunate event of lost keys, a penalty of £500 will be charged to cover replacement and re-keying costs.


Serenity and Quietness
To ensure a peaceful environment for all guests, please maintain quietness and calmness during your stay. Quiet hours are from 10 PM to 8 AM. No partying or disruptive activities are allowed, and any disturbances will be reported to the authorities.

A penalty of £90 will be charged for excessive garbage or messiness in the flat.

locationDescriptions.title: Bangangté, West, Cameroon
locationDescriptions.content:
Bangangte is a charming town located in the West Region of Cameroon, with a population of about 100,000 people. It is surrounded by picturesque scenery, including rolling hills and lush green forests. The region is known for its vibrant culture, with numerous festivals and celebrations throughout the year.

The city offers a unique opportunity to experience the local way of life and immerse themselves in the region's culture..

In terms of proximity to other popular places, Bangangte is located approximately 1h30min away from the Foumban Palace, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and an important cultural landmark in Cameroon. Mount Mbapit is also nearby, offering stunning views of the surrounding landscape and a challenging hike for adventurous travelers.

For those looking to explore further afield, Bangangte is situated roughly equidistant between Cameroon's two largest cities, Douala and Yaounde. Both cities offer a range of attractions and amenities, including museums, restaurants, and shopping centers. Yaounde, the capital city, is located approximately 200 km to the east, while Douala, the largest city and main seaport, is located approximately 250 km to the south. Bafoussam is another nearby city, located about 40 kilometers northwest of the city. It is known for its bustling markets, beautiful countryside, and traditional architecture. Guests can easily take a short trip to Bafoussam to explore the city's many attractions, including the Bafoussam Grand Market, the Mungo Park, and the Bafoussam Museum of Traditional Arts and Crafts.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
Getting around Bangangte is easy and convenient, with several transportation options available to guests. For those who prefer to explore on foot, the town's compact layout makes it easy to navigate and explore at a leisurely pace. Taxis and motorcycle taxis (commonly known as "moto" taxis) are also widely available and provide a convenient and affordable way to get around the town.

If you have your own car, the Villa offers free parking for guests. Additionally, we also offer car rental services for guests who prefer to have their own mode of transportation. Our staff can assist you in arranging for a rental car, which is a great option for those who want to explore the surrounding areas at their own pace.

Whether you prefer to walk, take a taxi, or rent a car, there are plenty of options available to help you get around Bangangté and make the most of your stay.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Few London neighbourhoods are as iconic as Notting Hill. Famous for its colourful streets, independent boutiques, cafés and restaurants, the area perfectly blends village charm with cosmopolitan living.

You’re just a short walk from the Tube station, making it easy to reach:

* Hyde Park
* Oxford Street
* Kensington
* Buckingham Palace
* Covent Garden
* Soho
* The West End
* Paddington Station
* Heathrow Airport via the Elizabeth Line

On weekends, don’t miss the famous Portobello Road Market, where you’ll find antiques, vintage fashion, artisan food and local treasures.

Perfect For

* Families
* Friends travelling together
* Couples
* Business travellers
* Weekend city breaks
* Extended stays

Hello Airbnb Community! I'm John, I am French but consider myself a citizen of the world. I am currently based in London but have a fondness for travelling and you're likely to find me globetrotting and staying in Airbnb's all over the place. 

I started hosting in 2010 in Paris with a friend, then gradually started helping other hosts manage guests in their properties. 

I look forward to welcoming you in one of my favourite cities soon!

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
About the Soho-Fitzrovia London Location:
Fitzrovia and its neighbour Soho form one of the most exciting creative hubs in central London. Fitzrovia is known for its independent restaurants, creative agencies, and lively Charlotte Street dining scene. Soho, immediately to the south, is London’s entertainment heart, packed with theatres, bars, restaurants, and an eclectic mix of people at all hours. Oxford Circus, Tottenham Court Road, and Goodge Street underground stations are all within minutes, giving superb connections across the city.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Enjoy staying in the heart of Fitzrovia, London with this modern 3-bedroom apartment located on the 1st floor of a secure residential building — NO LIFT. Self check-in from 3:00 PM by collecting keys at a nearby location. Wi-Fi is available, great for both work and leisure. A refundable damage deposit is required.

The space
Welcome to this modern 80 m² 3-bedroom apartment on the 1st floor of a building without a lift, perfectly situated on Charlotte Street in the heart of Fitzrovia. The apartment is professionally cleaned before every arrival so you can settle in straight away.

Bedroom 1: 1 Queen bed, Bedroom 2: 1 Queen bed, Bedroom 3: 1 Queen bed, Living room: 1 double sofa bed and 1 double bed. The apartment has a full en-suite bathroom in Bedroom 1 with a shower/bathtub, and a second full bathroom accessible via the hallway.

The living area is a great space to unwind, with a smart tv (flat screen) and dining table and chairs.

The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need: full fridge, oven, microwave, stove, dishwasher, drip DeLonghi coffee machine, and electric kettle and toaster. A combination washer-dryer is available for your convenience. The flat has floor heating (electric thermostat) and individual radiators throughout the cooler months.

Families welcome

Need a cot or high chair? We can arrange it for your arrival — just let us know after booking:
- Baby cot — £50 for the stay
- High chair — £50 for the stay
- Both together — £70 for the stay

Good to know before you book

Check-in: From 3:00 PM via self check-in — simply collect the keys at a nearby location. If you’re arriving after 7:00 PM and need someone to meet you with the keys, please let us know at least 24 hours in advance. Late arrivals between 7:00–9:59 PM incur a £50 fee; 10:00 PM–12:59 AM is £90; after 1:00 AM is £120. We’re flexible when we can be — just give us a heads-up!

Check-out: By 10:00 AM.

Damage deposit: A refundable damage deposit of £800 is required before arrival. It may be processed via a third-party payment provider such as Stripe, Swikly, or Flywire. The deposit is returned in full within 14 days of check-out following a standard inspection.

Max guests: 10 people (including children and infants). Please keep within this limit so everyone is comfortable.

Smoking: The apartment is non-smoking throughout.

Events: The apartment is a private home and not suitable for parties or events.

Guest access
The accommodation is private and exclusively for guests during their stay. Free Wi-Fi connection, information on London and restaurant recommendations, sheets, towels, soaps and much more.

Other things to note
Wi-Fi may occasionally be affected by area-wide connectivity issues. Please note a noise monitoring device is installed at the property entrance for extra security and to ensure the peace of the property. This device is not located in any sleeping area or bathroom. Photos are as accurate as possible — minor updates may not always be reflected immediately. Management may occasionally need access to the property for inspection, maintenance or viewings (between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM with reasonable notice). In genuine emergencies, access may be required without prior notice. We’ll always communicate as much as possible and be respectful of your stay.

locationDescriptions.title: Yaoundé, Centre Region, Cameroon
locationDescriptions.content:
The F-Square Apartments residence is located in Awae-Escalier (Maison Rouge area), on the edge of the Ekié and Nkomo neighborhoods.
Accessibility and amenities:
- Nsimalen Airport: Just 21 km away (about a 30–40-minute drive).
Downtown (Poste Centrale): Get to the administrative and commercial heart of the city in 25–30 minutes (5.6 miles).
- Groceries and shopping: The Carrefour Market in Ekié is less than 15 minutes away via the Carrefour de l'Amitié, making it easy to meet your daily needs.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
For a hassle-free arrival, we recommend using the Tank Oil gas station in Awae (formerly Nickel Oil) as your main landmark.
Itineraries depending on where you come from:
- From the Carrefour de l'Amitié: The Tank Oil gas station is on your right, just before you reach the Awae-Escalier intersection.
- From Nkomo: Cross the Awae-Escalier intersection in the direction of Carrefour de l'Amitié; the Tank Oil station will then be on your left.

Once at the Tank Oil station:
- Use the GPS coordinates we'll send you to cover the final stretch to the residence.
- The residence is accessible via two cul-de-sac streets.
- It is located precisely at the end of these two cul-de-sacs, which guarantees you a quiet stay without any vehicle traffic.
- Final step: As soon as you see the building, take the street below it, located just past the building, to get to the main entrance.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Located in a quiet and peaceful area, this exceptional apartment with a modern and refined design displays its style loud and clear. It has been designed in every detail to ensure you have a pleasant stay. A swimming pool with adjacent terrace is at your disposal and a backup electrical energy system is provided in the event of a power cut.

The space
With a surface area of 76 m2, this apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a beautiful modern and secure building. It has a living room, two bedrooms, a kitchen, two bathrooms and a balcony. Each of the bedrooms has a dedicated workstation. The apartment has two 65" smart TVs, one in the master bedroom which has its own private bathroom. The apartment also includes amenities such as an iron with ironing board, hairdryer, microwave, kitchen hood, electric oven, mixer robot and more.

Other things to note
Parties are not allowed in the apartments.

This apartment is equipped with a prepaid ENEO meter and the cost of charging is the responsibility of the customer beyond the included package (20kWh/D). In the event of a power outage, a backup system that incorporates solar panels will take over for a limited time. However, the backup will only cover basic needs (lighting, internet, TV, refrigerator, computer socket, etc.). Air conditioning, fridge, water heater, and other energy-intensive appliances will not be supplied in the event of an outage.

Electricity consumption management: 20kWh of electricity will be credited to the prepaid meter for each day, in proportion to the length of the stay. When this credit is exhausted, the customer will need to reload the meter at their own expense. And in this case, the refill information will be provided.

The pool and adjacent deck are made available free of charge and exclusively to duly declared residents. However, we reserve the right to close them to residents without prior notice. They are open from 8am to 10pm. All children aged 12 and under must be accompanied and supervised by a person aged 16 and over at all times.

Cleaning at no additional cost will be done every 3 days including changing linens and towels. You'll need to let us know your availability so that cleaning can be done in your presence.

For TV, as a general rule, we do not offer (for now) channels as such. The principle is to bring your own content (Netflix, Youtube, Amazon Prime Video, Canal+, etc.), and to connect directly to the TV or to project the content via the app of your mobile device (phone, tablet, etc.) which must be connected to the same Wi-Fi as the TV.

host.about: Welcome to The Quartz Place a collection of modern apartments in the heart of London. Just minutes from Waterloo and Lambeth North Station, each stay blends style, comfort, and convenience. With sleek interiors, spotless spaces, and easy self check-in, it’s the perfect base to explore Londons most iconic landmarks like the London Eye, Big Ben, and The Shard. All while enjoying exceptional local dining, shopping, and cultural experiences.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
🏙️ **Neighbourhood – Central London at Your Doorstep**
Welcome to SE1 — one of London’s most vibrant and well-connected areas. The Quartz Place is perfectly located within walking distance of Waterloo, South Bank, and Westminster, making it the ideal base for sightseeing, work, or relaxation.

🏛️ Iconic Landmarks Nearby
You're just minutes from London’s most famous attractions, including the London Eye, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, and the Houses of Parliament all easily reachable on foot.

🎭 **Culture, Arts & Entertainment**
Explore the Southbank Centre, National Theatre, BFI IMAX, and Tate Modern, or enjoy scenic riverside walks along the Thames.

🍽️ **Dining & Nightlife**
Discover a wide range of local restaurants, cafés, and traditional pubs — from casual street food to high-end dining options, all just around the corner.

🛍️ **Markets & Shopping**
Visit Lower Marsh Market for local gems, or head to Borough Market for gourmet street food. You’re also a short Tube ride from Covent Garden, Oxford Street, and the West End for world-class shopping.

🚇 **Excellent Transport Connections**
With Waterloo, Westminster, and Lambeth North stations nearby, you’ll have fast access to the Northern, Jubilee, Bakerloo lines and National Rail, connecting you to all corners of the city.

💼 **Business Travel Ready**
Ideal for business travellers with quick access to **The City, Canary Wharf**, and major transport hubs.

🔊 **City Energy**
The apartment is situated on a main road — offering fantastic connectivity and an authentic central London atmosphere, with some expected city background noise.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
🚆 Getting Around – Excellent Transport Links

🚇 Waterloo Station (5–7 min walk): Major transport hub with access to the Jubilee, Northern, Bakerloo, and Waterloo & City lines, plus National Rail services — connecting you across London and beyond.

🚇 Lambeth North Station (3 min walk): On the Bakerloo Line with direct trains to Oxford Circus, Piccadilly Circus, and Paddington.

🚇 Westminster Station (10 min walk): Serviced by the Jubilee, District, and Circle Lines for easy access to the West End, the City, and Canary Wharf.

🚍 24/7 Bus Routes: Frequent day and night buses run along the main road directly outside the property, offering quick and convenient travel across Central London.

🚶 Walkable Attractions: You're just steps from world-famous sights including the London Eye, Big Ben, South Bank, Westminster Abbey, and the Tate Modern.

🚲 Santander Cycles: Bike hire stations are nearby, perfect for scenic rides along the Thames Path or through central London.

🚗 Driving & Parking: As with most central London locations, on-street parking is limited. Free parking is available after 6.30pm on the street. Several public car parks are available within walking distance if needed.

The apartment also features a main bathroom, perfect for everyday use.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Located directly opposite Buckingham Palace, in the upmarket & highly sought-after St James’s Park (Westminster).

A beautiful neighbourhood, which is extremely safe and secure. Proximity to the palace means the area is very safe to walk around at all times!

Lots of great restaurants, cafes, delis, bars in the area. We share a digital map of the top places to visit prior to arrival.

Just a couple of minutes walk to London’s most picturesque Royal Parks:

- St James's Park: Home to Englands only Pink Pelicans, and friendly Parakeets. Great kids play area and lots of wildlife which is entertaining for kids!)

- Green Park: Cross the palace to reach the luscious green park, stroll by the Ritz or Fortnum and Mason for afternoon tea.

Zone 1, super central location - fabulous for walking to major attractions, shops, restaurants etc. 10-20 mins walk to London Landmarks including:

- Trafalgar Square
- Hyde Park
- Whitechapel
- 10 Downing Street
- The Big Ben
- Westminster abbey
- London eye
- Piccadilly Circus / Leicester Sq
- St James Palace etc.
- Soho & The west-end
- Knightsbridge & Belgravia

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Directly across the road from Buckingham Palace, a superb 1800 sq ft Apartment, in a 19th-century Grade II Listed townhouse.

Meticulously appointed, with private parking, luxe interiors & 24/7 concierge, this exceptional property boasts 2 Bedrooms (Sleeps 7), 3 Bathrooms, a Chef's kitchen, spacious living & dining area, a separate utility room - & a private terrace.

Ultra-prime Central London location - just a 5-10min walk to Westminster abbey, Ldn Eye, Big Ben, Downing st & Mayfair.

The space
A breathtaking, super-impressive & grand Two bedroom, 2.5 bathroom Duplex apartment.

Extremely spacious, comprising 1800 Sq Ft / 170 Sq Meters. Arranged over two floors, this apartment is also accompanied by a beautiful private garden courtyard.

Situated directly opposite Buckingham Palace the apartment enjoys a centrality of location that few others possess - at the very heart of London’s most distinguished address.

The magnificent Grade II listed property was built between 1859-1861; designed by architect Sir James Pennethorne, who also designed the south wing of Buckingham Palace.

Accommodation Amenities

• Bedroom 1: Master bedroom with marble ensuite bathroom (with bath + shower)

• Bedroom 2: King Guest bedroom with marble ensuite bathroom (shower) (Option to add sofa bed)

• Open plan living and dining room (10meter+),

• Large, open plan lounge (with Double Sofa Bed)

• Formal Dining area (with table to seat 6-8 guests)

• Family kitchen, with large Island for dining and premium appliances

• Marble Guest washroom

• Entrance hall with large guest cloakroom

• Utility room with separate washer and dryer, and plenty of luggage storage space

• Private walled garden

• Secure underground car parking

• Lift access

• 24-hour concierge & Security

• Air-conditioning and underfloor heating.

Also included:
- Lifestyle concierge access to help with trip planning
- Breakfast & Snacks
- TV with Netflix, Prime
- x2 Alexa sound systems
- Books, Cards, Poker set etc.
- Daily Newspaper Delivery (The Times)
- Secure garage for Bike or pram storage.

ADDITIONAL FEATURES!

- Also available: Luxury 1 bedroom apartment within the same building. This is extremely convenient if travelling with staff or a nanny, or in need of additional space.

- Private secure parking within car stacker in building garage.

- Guests enjoy access to an exclusive luxury lifestyle concierge service for assistance with planning their trips and making reservations at London's hotspots.

- Breakfast and snacks included - don't arrive to an empty fridge! Granola, fruit, yoghurt, milk, juice, soft drinks, crips etc will be stocked for your arrival.

- Weekly housekeeping is provided with our compliments on stays of 7+ days. Daily cleaning / housekeeping can be arranged as frequently as desired during your stay (daily, every other day, or just on departure).

- Additional services can be arranged: Chef/catering, massages and beauty treatments, personal trainer, babysitter, personal shopping, transport, car hire (delivered to the building!) etc.

Guest access
Access to the entire space, private garden and secure car-stacker parking.

- Private access to entire apartment and terrace.
- Access via a luxury reception with a 24 hour concierge
- First floor apartment, with external lift also allowing access to the second floor
- Can facilitate any special requests or needs, just ask!
- Generally flexible re: early check in or late check out times, just let me know what you need.
- Guests can check in at their own convenience, with concierge on hand to provide access at any time.
- Please let me know if cot / baby items are required.

Other things to note
Guests can also request assistance with extras such as car hire, catering services, mobile beauty services etc.

There is also access to the apartment via the concierge entrance, with a discreet third access and service route via the car park.

Pre-Order Groceries: we can arrange, or accept a grocery delivery (e.g. Amazon fresh) for guests in advance of arrival if you prefer, so the fridge is stocked when you check in. Just shoot me a message after booking.

Bag drop off is always available (anytime on the day of check in!) - if you're in town way before check in.

Usually flexible to allow early check-in & late check-out times, just ask.
We always endeavour to allow guests flying redeye to check in straight from the airport!

Advance delivery of luggage - happy to facilitate a few days prior to arrival, let me know.

Can facilitate any special requests or needs, just ask!

Please let me know if cot / baby items are required.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Make some memories whether you are taking a walk at the river or enjoying our scenic Panorama route. We cater for Nature lovers young and old at Bikers Rest. Guided tours, Outrides and Picnic's can be arranged. We are an ECO LODGE completely reliant on Solar power. Be sure to bring along your mountain bike for exploring.

The space
Fully Self-Catering Accommodation along the Panorama Route

Situated outside Graskop, just off the R532 towards Blyde River Canyon,
Lisbon Hideaway serves as the ideal base from which to explore an extensive
range of Mpumalanga’s most admired sites and activities.

Two quick turn-offs from the R532 onto a short (350m) gravel road reveals
the serene, tranquil surroundings of Lisbon Hideaway’s three timber chalets
and one stone cottage, hidden between wetlands, nature reserve and the
crystal-clear Lisbon River.

Experience the peace and tranquility of a peaceful hideaway where a cool
breeze always provides relief after a busy day`s sightseeing.

Guest access
We have 3 Log Cabins and 1 Miner's Cottage. Each Log Cabin sleeps 6 people and the rate charged per day is the price for 6 people per day. The rate charged for the Miner's Cottage is for 2 people per day. We have big open spaces if guests want to go for a walk whether by the river or on the property or even to the Lisbon waterfall.

Other things to note
Guided tours, Outrides, Picnic's etc. can be catered for by prior arrangement.
We are an ECO LODGE completely reliant on Solar power.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
This tiny off-grid mountain cabin has a true sense of peace and calm about it.

It is situated a stone's throw from Blyde River Canyon in the Northern Drakensberg and only a short drive to the Kruger Park.

The views from the deck over the entire Lowveld are amazing, while the Mariepskop mountain looms over you at the back.


For any activities, such as mountain hikes, safari or sightseeing trips, please contact host Marcel.
Phone reception is great but there's no WiFi.

The space
This cabin is a tiny house, but comes fully equipped. There's a kitchen, fridge, washing machine, bathroom and double bed. Water comes straight from the mountain.

It has a large deck to enjoy the 360 views, with a firepit and a charcoal braai.

Everything you need to come at peace and enjoy the mountain.

Guest access
There is an electric gate at the bottom of the property.
For entry/exit, call Martin to phone open the gate.

The cabin is right at the end of the road. Follow the signs for 'Marepe mountain lodge' till you are there. With the lodge on your left, take the short driveway on the right to the cabin.

When available, Marcel will drive you up to the cabin.

Hidden in amongst the mango and citrus farms next to the Blyde River it is a true hidden gem, our two cabins offer accommodation for a stop over on your trip, a family holiday, a romantic getaway or a base to explore the area. The river is unpolluted, with crystal clear water that one can swim in. There is a beautiful 5km trail along the river, and there is the opportunity to fish for Bass, Carp, yellow fish and tilapia in the river. htmlDescription.htmlText:
Experience resort-level luxury in this 6-BRM Brillasol residence, set in lush tropical gardens with a stunning round pool, palm trees, and plenty of sun loungers for lazy days in the sun.

The villa’s elegant interiors with a stylish piano corner invites you to enjoy live music evenings and special celebrations.

Inside, guests enjoy six refined bedrooms plus a private spa level with hammam, sauna, indoor Jacuzzi, and a fully equipped fitness room for a complete wellness retreat.

The space
Six spacious, air‑conditioned bedrooms with premium bedding and contemporary decor.

Grand living and dining areas with large TV, piano, designer lighting, and full-height curtains.

Fully equipped kitchen (stove, oven, fridge, microwave, coffee machine, blender, cookware, utensils).

Private spa: hammam, dry sauna, and indoor Jacuzzi.Dedicated fitness room with gym equipment .

Large round swimming pool, sun loungers, umbrellas, landscaped gardens, and secure gated parking.

High‑speed Wi‑Fi and housekeeping available.

Guest access
Guests have exclusive access to the entire residence: all 6 bedrooms, spa (hammam, sauna, Jacuzzi), gym, piano area, living and dining rooms, kitchen, terrace, gardens, pool, and on-site parking.

The villa sits a short drive from Kribi’s beaches, La Lobé waterfalls, and popular seafood restaurants, combining privacy with quick access to the area’s highlights.

Other things to note
Spa, gym, pool, and piano should be used carefully; children must always be supervised around water and wellness equipment.

Daily or on‑request cleaning, private chef, airport/bus transfers, and curated excursions can be arranged.

No smoking indoors, no unauthorized parties, and quiet hours from 11 PM to 7 AM keep the residence calm and exclusive.

Chic & Central London Haven | Steps from Oxford St (Sleeps 6)
The perfect West End base for families, friends, or business travelers seeking the ultimate London experience.


Nestled just moments away from Tottenham Court Road Station and the bustling energy of Oxford Street, this stylishly curated apartment brings you the very best of central London right to your doorstep. Blending classic British charm with modern comfort, the space features playful royal-themed decor, sleek hardwood floors, and all the amenities you need for an effortless city stay.

The Space
Conveniently located on the first floor for easy access, this apartment offers a peaceful, stylish retreat whether you are here to shop on Regent Street, catch a West End show, or explore historic Soho.🇬🇧

Living & Dining Area: A bright, inviting space featuring a comfortable deep-blue sofa (which easily converts into a double bed), a flat-screen smart TV, and a glass-topped dining table perfect for planning your day over morning coffee.

The "Royal" Bedroom: A spacious, beautifully lit bedroom equipped with two comfortable double beds, premium white linens, and eye-catching British pop-art.

Modern Bathroom: A clean, fully tiled bathroom complete with a deep soaking bathtub, a luxurious overhead rainfall shower, and a heated towel rail.

Sleeping Arrangements (Accommodates up to 6 Guests)
Bedroom: Two plush Double Beds (Sleeps 4)

Living Room: One comfortable Double Sofa Bed (Sleeps 2)

Key Amenities
Unbeatable Location: 2-minute walk to Tottenham Court Road Station (Elizabeth, Central, and Northern Lines) and Oxford Street.

Entertainment: Flat-screen Smart TV in the living room for streaming .
Comforts: Fresh, high-quality linens, plush towels, and complimentary toiletries provided.

WIFI: High-speed internet throughout the property, perfect for remote work or streaming.

The Neighborhood
You couldn't ask for a more central London location. Step outside and you are minutes away from:

Shopping: Oxford Street, Regent Street, and Carnaby.

Dining & Nightlife: The endless cafes, pubs, and world-class restaurants of Soho and Fitzrovia.

Culture: The British Museum and Covent Garden's famous theatres are just a short stroll away.

Transit: Unrivaled tube links mean Heathrow Airport, the City, and London’s major landmarks are easily accessible in minutes.

Other things to note
Based on first floor

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Take it easy at this unique, tranquil off-grid getaway.

The secluded and private Stone Cottage is nestled among lush indigenous trees and next to an irrigation canal. Thatched and built from stone, the cottage offers stunning views into a verdant garden and over a farm dam. Everything on the property, from the food we grow to how we live, and generate electricity, is based on being environmentally sustainable. South Africa's leading lithography studio, The Artists' Press, is also located here.

The space
The bedroom is upstairs and has a double bed with pure cotton linen, a feather duvet in winter and a light cotton quilt for summer. The generous windows offer views of the tree canopy and are ideal for birdwatching. Relax on the bed and watch kingfishers, paradise flycatchers and purple crested turacos in the branches. As the sun sets, you may be lucky to spot our resident bushbabies.

Downstairs, there is a well-equipped kitchen, a calm working space, and a living area with a cosy wood fireplace and ample comfy seating. The bathroom is brightly mosaiced and includes a shower and a closable door.

- Fast, stable wifi
- dedicated worktable with an ergonomic chair
- stable electricity 24/7

Outside the cottage is an outdoor braai and seating area above a gently gurgling canal in the shade of banana and waterberry trees. The downstairs bathroom is brightly mosaiced and includes a shower.

Guest access
Guests can explore the four-hectare mostly indigenous sub-tropical food forest garden and have shared access to the secluded eco swimming pool (being eco, there are tadpoles in the pool, depending on the season).

We established The Artists' Press in Johannesburg in 1991 and moved to the Lowveld in 2002. Mark Attwood is a master printer and has been printing since 1982. We print limited edition hand-printed prints (mostly lithographs) and collaborate with some of southern Africa's leading artists. Guests are welcome to pop into the studio to see what we do. If an artist is in residence, you will get to meet them, too.

In addition to the Stone Cottage and studio, there is our house, the Artists' House, Farm House and our daughter's apartment on the property. Please be respectful of each residential building's privacy and need for quiet.

Other things to note
Our entire property is off-grid. Our electricity is provided by solar and our micro-hydro system. We have ample electricity, including enough to charge our fully electric vehicle. This means that we never have load-shedding. Our water is provided by our borehole, which is treated with UV and is perfectly safe to drink. The trees in the garden provide us with loads of firewood for fireplaces and braai areas. We have four bee hives, so we are off-grid for honey too! All food waste is fed to our hens in their chicken tractor.

We receive no municipal services; our trash is taken to a registered dump site by a private company. We ask you to help us by separating the recyclables from your trash. We have 24-hour security provided by a company that patrols the valley.

No wheelchair access.
No children under the age of 10 years old.
No pets (including dogs) allowed.
Access to the bedroom is via stairs.
The bedroom and the bathroom are not on the same level.
Not suitable for infirm elderly people or partially sighted people. Please look at the photos to have a better understanding.

locationDescriptions.content: Located in the Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate, Kingfisher Cottage has the dual attraction of being close to the restaurants and shops of Hoedspruit whilst providing easy access to the Greater Kruger and the Blyde River Canyon. Development in the estate consists of a mixture of private houses and commercial lodges. The balance of the estate is undeveloped “greenbelt” which is home to a wide variety of game including giraffe, wildebeest, kudu and zebra. Birdlife in the estate is also prolific. Kingfisher Cottage is unfenced and during the day warthog are regular visitors and at night be sure to look out for the resident porcupine.  As the estate is surrounded by big five reserves if you sit quietly at night you will often hear the roaring of lion and the whooping of hyena.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Kingfisher Cottage is an ideal escape from city life. Located in the Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate, it has the attraction of being close to the restaurants and shops of Hoedspruit whilst providing access to the Greater Kruger & the Blyde River Canyon. The cottage is available to rent for short term stays of 2-14 nights for up to 4 adults on an exclusive basis. If you are a larger family please contact me to see if arrangements can be made. Cottage has solar and battery backup power.

The space
Guests have the entire house to themselves and exclusive use of the pool and braai area. The upstairs space is an open plan loft (bedrooms 2 and 3 do not have doors). Although privacy screens are available this space is best suited for families or children. The downstairs main bedroom is en-suite and opens directly onto the deck. The kitchen is large and fully equipped for self catering. The open plan lounge / dining room opens on to the deck.

Guest access
Access to the property is through the boomed gates of Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate. An access pass will be sent to you in advance of your stay. The access pass will be valid for the duration of your stay and you can enter and exit the estate multiple times. Please advise if you will be travelling in more than 1 vehicle as 1 pass per vehicle is required. There is a carport on the property with space for 2 cars. Access to the house is via an electronic lock on the back door. The pin code for the lock will be sent to you in advance.

Other things to note
Power is supplied by Eskom with solar and battery backup in the event of a power failure or loadshedding. Please note the oven and air conditioners will not work while operating off solar/battery.

The cottage is available on a self-catering basis only. There is a fully equipped kitchen and braai and a number of restaurants in the area that are easily accessible. The house is also rented unserviced. Should you require a cleaning service during your stay please contact me as this can be arranged for an additional cost.

There is another cottage on the property which is not rented out to guests and is only occasionally used by the owner. Guests at Kingfisher Cottage have exclusive use of the outdoor facilities including the pool and boma / braai area.

On weekday mornings and evenings there is some road noise from the nearby airforce force base road as employees from the base travel to and from work.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Peaceful self-catering cottage accommodation on a macadamia and dragon-fruit farm near White River, Mpumalanga. Just 8km from White River town, 15km from KMIA Airport and under 30km from Kruger National Park. Ideal for couples, solo travellers and holiday guests seeking a relaxing farm stay.

Enjoy secure surroundings, nature views, a shared plunge pool, and easy access to restaurants, shops, scenic drives, adventure activities and safari experiences in the Lowveld.

The space
Aloe Arbour Farm House is a spacious self-catering farmhouse in White River, Mpumalanga, ideal for families, couples or groups of up to 4 guests. Set on a peaceful working farm, this private countryside escape offers comfort, space and convenience near Kruger National Park and KMIA Airport.

Guests are welcomed with complimentary milk and water, plus first-night essentials including tea, coffee, cooking oil, tomato sauce, salt, pepper, charcoal and firelighters.

The main bedroom features a king-size bed, air-conditioning, ceiling fan and en-suite bathroom with double basin, shower and toilet. The second bedroom has two three-quarter beds and a ceiling fan, with a second bathroom nearby including shower, basin and toilet. A sleeper couch in the lounge provides additional sleeping space.

Enjoy year-round comfort with electric blankets on all beds and a gas heater in winter. Linen, bath towels and swimming towels are provided.

The fully equipped kitchen includes a washing machine, dishwasher, washing liquid, dishwasher pods and washing powder for easy extended stays.

Relax on the private patio with seating and dining space overlooking the farm and private swimming pool. A built-in braai is perfect for outdoor meals and sundowners.

Additional features include free Wi-Fi, Smart TV with Netflix and Disney+, housekeeping Monday to Saturday, and secure accommodation with electric fencing and AI-monitored cameras.

Check-in: 3pm to 10pm
Check-out: Before 10am

Guest access
Guests are more than welcome to walk or run on the farm. The security on the farm is provided by electric fencing and monitored by AI enabled outdoor cameras with voice back-up

Other things to note
What guests have to say...

A beautiful and cozy cottage, ideal for a nice getaway in nature. Candy and Steve were wonderful and attentive hosts who went out of their way to make sure our stay was as comfortable as possible. The cottage caters for all seasons (gas heater and swimming pool) and also has backup power. Above all, it was safe and clean. Would highly recommend.

Absolutely loved staying here and would 100% go back. Accommodation and surroundings are just beautiful. Had all the perfect little touches that make a stay special from chocolates on arrival to peaceful sleep on the nightstands and more. Felt safe and secure at all times. Would definitely recommend to anybody wanting to stay.

It was great at Caroline's place. She's a super host, and the place was lovely. She responded very quickly to questions and took good care of us.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
📍Neighbourhood
Located on the picturesque, tree-lined street in the heart of Kensington, this beautiful home places you in one of West London's most desirable neighbourhoods. Combining peaceful residential charm with easy access to some of London's most iconic attractions, it's the perfect base for families, business travellers and those looking to experience the city like a local.
Just a short stroll away, Kensington High Street offers an excellent selection of boutiques, cafes, restaurants and supermarkets, while the charming streets surrounding the property are home to independent coffee shops, local pubs and hidden neighbourhood favourites.
Nature lovers can enjoy the tranquillity of Holland Park and the stunning Kyoto Garden, while Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park are also within easy reach for morning walks, picnics or leisurely afternoons. Culture is never far away, with Kensington Palace, the Natural History Museum, the Victoria & Albert Museum and the Science Museum all nearby.

With High Street Kensington and Earl's Court Underground stations within walking distance, you'll have excellent transport links across London, making it easy to explore world-famous landmarks including Buckingham Palace, Covent Garden, Notting Hill, Oxford Street and the West End.

☕ Local Favourites
R&H Cafe Gallery – A wonderful neighbourhood cafe serving speciality coffee, brunch and homemade cakes.
Cafe de Fred – A cosy local favourite for breakfast, lunch and excellent coffee.
Treelogy Speciality Coffee – Perfect for artisan coffee and fresh pastries.

The Abingdon – A traditional gastropub offering seasonal British cuisine.
Bottega 35 – Authentic Italian dining just a short walk away.
La Palombe – Elegant French cuisine for a special evening.
Jacuzzi – One of London's most popular Italian restaurants, famous for its spectacular interiors.

🌿 Nearby Attractions
Holland Park & Kyoto Garden
Kensington Palace
Kensington Gardens & Hyde Park
Natural History Museum
Victoria & Albert Museum
Science Museum
Design Museum
Kensington High Street shopping

Whether you're visiting for sightseeing, shopping, dining or business, Abingdon Villas offers the perfect combination of peaceful surroundings and easy access to everything London has to offer.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
A classic Kensington townhouse on a quiet residential street, this elegant London home combines timeless charm with modern luxury. A designer kitchen with a marble island opens onto a private walled garden, perfect for relaxing after a day in the city. Upstairs, the main bedroom features a freestanding bath and garden views. Holland Park, Kensington Gardens, Hyde Park, Kensington Palace and world-class museums are all within easy reach.

The space
Whether you're enjoying morning coffee in the secluded garden, entertaining in the stunning designer kitchen or exploring the boutiques, cafes and museums that Kensington is renowned for, this home offers an unforgettable stay for families, professionals or friends seeking luxury in one of London's finest postcodes.

The Space
Set across multiple floors, this beautifully appointed townhouse offers generous living areas, luxurious bedrooms and exceptional entertaining space throughout.

Ground Floor
Step inside into an elegant entrance level where you'll find a welcoming formal lounge, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring London. Adjacent is a cosy snug with a dedicated desk area, ideal for catching up on work or enjoying a quiet moment.

Also on this floor is a modern family bathroom complete with a walk-in shower, wash basin and WC.

Lower Ground Floor
Descending the stairs, you'll discover the heart of the home.
A second lounge with a large television creates the perfect space for movie nights before opening into an impressive designer kitchen featuring a substantial marble island, premium appliances and a spacious dining area.

Large doors lead directly onto the beautifully landscaped private garden, thoughtfully furnished to create an exceptional outdoor living and dining space perfect for morning coffee, al fresco lunches or evening drinks in complete privacy.

First Floor
Heading upstairs from the entrance level, you'll pass a peaceful seating area with a two person sofa before reaching the luxurious principal suite.

The spacious master bedroom features a king size bed, ample wardrobe storage and a truly stunning en-suite bathroom complete with both a freestanding bath and separate walk-in shower, creating a spa like retreat.

Second Floor
On the top floor you'll find a further family bathroom with a bath and overhead shower, alongside two additional beautifully furnished bedrooms:
King-size bedroom with a desk/dressing table
Double bedroom with ample storage
Each room has been thoughtfully designed with comfort and style in mind.

Why You'll Love It
• Beautifully renovated luxury townhouse
• Three elegant bedrooms
• Three stylish bathrooms
• Two spacious lounges plus separate snug
• Stunning designer kitchen with large island
• Exceptional private landscaped garden
• High-end furnishings and luxury finishes throughout
• Located on one of Kensington's most desirable streets
• Walking distance to Kensington High Street, Holland Park and Kensington Gardens

Home Truths
• The property is arranged over several floors and includes multiple staircases, so may not be suitable for guests with limited mobility.
• Due to the multi-level layout, young children should be supervised on the stairs.

Guest access
Whole house

Other things to note

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Bask in pure luxury in our 3 Bedroom duplex Penthouse with a large, wrap around, beautifully architectured terrace. Enjoy the phenomenal, panoramic views of the London Skyline. This VIP experience doesn't end there as should you choose to explore your surroundings, you are a stones throw from Leicester Square tube station and all that the world renowned 'Covent Garden' has to offer.

The space
The lower floor houses all three bedrooms, two with ensuite, and all three with fantastic views. One bedroom also has a separate private balcony, so guest can take in the scenery from the comfort of their own bedroom. There is also a family bathroom on the lower floor.

The upstairs landing offers the main access to the wrap around terrace where guests can sit in the outdoor chairs or dine with friends and family. Inside, the space leads on to an open plan, living, kitchen and dining room, complete with absolutely everything one might wish for to ensure a VIP central London experience. From the living, dining area guests can enjoy views of many of the famous buildings such as the London eye & The Shard.

***Please note that the small bedroom does not have air conditioning. The rest of the flat is air-conditioned for your comfort.

Guest access
Guest access is via the main building front door followed by the lift or stairs to the top floor.

Other things to note
No parties of events of any kind. Rule breaking will be taken very seriously. CCTV is present and monitored outside the flat and the building has 24 hour security and a concierge.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Knightsbridge, one of London's most exclusive and affluent neighborhoods, exudes elegance, sophistication, and timeless charm. Situated in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, Knightsbridge is renowned for its luxury shopping, exquisite architecture, and cultural landmarks.

At the heart of Knightsbridge lies its iconic thoroughfare, Brompton Road, home to some of the world's most prestigious retailers. Here, you'll find renowned department stores such as Harrods and Harvey Nichols, offering an unparalleled shopping experience with an array of designer boutiques, high-end fashion brands, and luxury goods.

Aside from its shopping allure, Knightsbridge boasts a rich cultural tapestry. The neighborhood is dotted with historic landmarks, including the Victoria and Albert Museum and the Natural History Museum, both showcasing an impressive collection of art, artifacts, and scientific exhibits.

Hyde Park, one of London's largest and most beloved green spaces, forms the northern boundary of Knightsbridge. This sprawling oasis provides residents and visitors alike with a tranquil escape from the bustling city streets. From leisurely strolls along Serpentine Lake to picnics on lush lawns, Hyde Park offers endless opportunities for relaxation and recreation.

Knightbridge's architectural landscape is a harmonious blend of grand Victorian townhouses, Georgian terraces, and modern luxury developments. Imposing mansion blocks and elegant garden squares contribute to the neighborhood's picturesque allure, evoking a sense of timeless grandeur.

Culinary delights abound in Knightsbridge, with a plethora of upscale restaurants, chic cafes, and gourmet eateries catering to discerning palates. From haute cuisine establishments to cozy bistros serving international fare, there's something to satisfy every taste.

Whether strolling along its tree-lined avenues, indulging in world-class shopping, or savoring the culinary delights on offer, Knightsbridge encapsulates the epitome of London luxury living, making it a coveted destination for residents and visitors alike.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content: Nestled within the iconic Notting Hill area, Holland Park stands as a captivating and sophisticated neighbourhood, known for its unique blend of affluent charm and cultural richness. Here's a glimpse into the vibrant atmosphere of this distinguished locale: Lush Greenery: Holland Park is renowned for its picturesque public park after which the neighbourhood is named. Spanning over 50 acres, the park is a haven of tranquillity, featuring beautifully landscaped gardens, woodlands, and the peaceful Kyoto Garden, providing residents and visitors with an enchanting retreat from the urban bustle. Elegant Residences: The streets of Holland Park are lined with elegant townhouses and upscale residences, showcasing architectural beauty and timeless appeal. This residential enclave exudes a refined atmosphere, creating an ideal setting for those seeking a luxurious and peaceful lifestyle. Cultural Hub: The neighbourhood boasts a rich cultural scene, with the famous Holland Park Opera attracting music enthusiasts from around the city. Additionally, the Design Museum and the Leighton House Museum contribute to the area's cultural diversity, providing residents with easy access to artistic and historical experiences. Chic Shopping and Dining: Stroll down Holland Park Avenue or venture into nearby Notting Hill to discover a myriad of boutiques, high-end shops, and fashionable eateries. The area is synonymous with sophistication, offering a diverse range of culinary delights and upscale shopping experiences. Community Vibe: While exuding an air of exclusivity, Holland Park maintains a welcoming community atmosphere. Local events, farmer's markets, and community gatherings foster a sense of camaraderie among residents, creating a neighbourhood where people can truly feel at home.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content: The nearest Tube stations are Ladbroke Grove (Circle & Hammersmith & City lines) and Westbourne Park (Circle & Hammersmith & City lines), both within a short walk. Numerous bus routes serve the area, providing easy access to central London and beyond. Paddington Station, with National Rail and the Elizabeth Line, is also nearby, offering fast connections to Heathrow and other parts of the city. Cycling routes and Santander bike hire stations are also available in the area.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Mayfair is one of London’s most prestigious and affluent neighborhoods, known for its luxury, elegance, and exclusivity. Located in the heart of the West End, it is bordered by Hyde Park to the west, Regent Street to the east, Oxford Street to the north, and Piccadilly to the south.

Key Features of Mayfair:

1. Luxury Real Estate & Architecture

Home to grand Georgian and Victorian townhouses, historic mansions, and ultra-modern penthouses.
Some of the most expensive property in the world, with homes often selling for tens of millions of pounds.
Notable addresses include Grosvenor Square (formerly home to the U.S. Embassy) and Mount Street, known for its opulent residences.
2. High-End Shopping & Fashion

Bond Street (Old & New) is a global luxury shopping destination, housing flagship stores for Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Prada, and Cartier.
Savile Row is synonymous with bespoke tailoring, home to legendary suit-makers like Gieves & Hawkes and Huntsman.
Burlington Arcade, a historic covered shopping lane, offers high-end jewelry and accessories.
3. Fine Dining & Exclusive Members' Clubs

Michelin-starred restaurants like Le Gavroche (closed in 2024), Hélène Darroze at The Connaught, and Sketch.
Iconic hotels such as Claridge’s, The Connaught, and The Dorchester offer world-class dining and afternoon tea.
Private members' clubs like Annabel’s, 5 Hertford Street, and The Arts Club cater to elite socialites and celebrities.
4. Art & Culture

A hub for high-end art galleries, including Sotheby’s, Phillips, and Hauser & Wirth on Bond Street.
Close to The Royal Academy of Arts on Piccadilly, hosting major exhibitions.
5. Business & Diplomacy

Home to hedge funds, private equity firms, and family offices, particularly around Curzon Street and Berkeley Square.
Historically diplomatic, with Grosvenor Square previously hosting the U.S. Embassy (now relocated to Nine Elms).
6. Green Spaces & Quiet Elegance

Despite its central location, Mayfair has peaceful garden squares like Berkeley Square and Hanover Square.
Close to Hyde Park, offering a retreat from city life.
Atmosphere & Lifestyle

Mayfair exudes sophistication, attracting billionaires, aristocrats, and international elites. It balances old-world charm with contemporary luxury, making it one of London’s most desirable and exclusive neighborhoods.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
1. Walking (Best for Short Distances)

Mayfair is compact and pedestrian-friendly, with many key attractions within a 10-20 minute walk:
Oxford Street (shopping) – 5 mins
Bond Street (luxury boutiques) – 3 mins
Piccadilly Circus – 10 mins
Green Park / Hyde Park – 10-15 mins
2. London Underground (Tube) – Fastest for Longer Trips

The closest Tube stations to Maddox Street are:

Oxford Circus (2 min walk) – Central, Victoria, Bakerloo lines
Bond Street (5 min walk) – Central, Jubilee, Elizabeth lines
Green Park (10 min walk) – Jubilee, Piccadilly, Victoria lines
Key Tube Routes from Mayfair:

To Westminster / Big Ben: Jubilee line (Bond St → Westminster, ~7 mins)
To Covent Garden / Leicester Square: Piccadilly line (Green Park → Covent Garden, ~5 mins)
To Canary Wharf / The City: Jubilee line (Bond St → Canary Wharf, ~12 mins)
To Heathrow Airport: Elizabeth line (Bond St → Heathrow, ~30 mins)
💡 Tip: Use contactless (Oyster card, Apple Pay, or bank card) for seamless travel—no need to buy paper tickets.

3. Buses (Scenic & Convenient for Short Hops)

Multiple bus routes pass near Maddox Street:
12, 94, 139 (Oxford Street routes) – Good for Soho, Trafalgar Square
22, 453 – Runs to Piccadilly Circus, Westminster
6, 23 – Goes to Knightsbridge (Harrods), Chelsea
💡 Use Citymapper or Google Maps for real-time bus arrivals.

4. Black Cabs & Ride-Hailing (For Convenience or Late Nights)

Black cabs are reliable and can be hailed on the street (or at taxi ranks near hotels).
Uber / Bolt / FreeNow work well, but avoid surge pricing during peak hours.
To key destinations:
St. Pancras (Eurostar): ~15 mins (£15-20)
Tower of London: ~20 mins (£20-25)
5. Cycling (If You Prefer Eco-Friendly Travel)

Santander Cycles (Boris Bikes) docking stations are nearby (e.g., Hanover Square).
Lime / Tier e-bikes are also available via apps.
Caution: London traffic can be busy—stick to cycle lanes.
6. Elizabeth Line (For Fast Cross-City & Airport Travel)

Bond Street Station (5 min walk) has the Elizabeth line, which is great for:
Heathrow Airport (30 mins)
Canary Wharf (12 mins)
Liverpool Street (10 mins)
7. Private Chauffeurs & Car Rentals (For Luxury Travel)

Many high-end hotels offer Rolls-Royce or Mercedes transfers.
Car rentals (Avis, Hertz) are available, but driving in central London is not recommended due to congestion charges (£15/day) and limited parking.
Best Option?

For speed: Tube (especially Jubilee/Elizabeth lines)
For short trips: Walk or bus
For late nights / convenience: Black cabs or Uber

The space
Connaught Place is a premier Grade II listed townhouse overlooking Hyde Park. This award-winning duplex accommodates up to ten guests across four ensuite suites, and a gym that could be converted into a fifth ensuite bedroom with a sauna and steam room included.

Other highlights include a 13m reception room, a 1,000 sq ft private terrace, a cinema, and a wellness suite with a gym and sauna. Designed by 1508 London, the interiors blend Regency heritage with Gaggenau appliances and full home automation. Residents enjoy concierge services via a staffed desk next door. A rare and singular London address.

The space
This exceptional residence spans two floors, anchored by a grand 13-meter south-facing reception room. This space flows directly onto an extraordinary 1,000 sq ft private terrace featuring a contemporary firepit—perfect for sophisticated outdoor entertaining.

Wellness & Leisure (Lower Floor) The lower level serves as a dedicated sanctuary for relaxation and entertainment:

•⁠ ⁠Wellness Suite: A private gymnasium fully equipped with a sauna and steam room.

•⁠ ⁠Media Room: A cinema-grade environment designed by world-leading acoustician Neil Grant, featuring an 84" 4K UHD screen, surround sound, and a custom wet bar.

•⁠ ⁠The Snug: An intimate living space with an antique mirrored bronze fireplace and access to a glass-fronted wine store.
Gourmet & Technology

•⁠ ⁠Kitchen: A sleek, contemporary kitchen fitted with full Gaggenau appliances, Marron Cohiba granite worktops, and a larch veneer island.

•⁠ ⁠Automation: A powerful Gira HomeServer system puts lighting, heating, and AV controls at your fingertips via iPad or iPhone.

Bedroom Suites Accommodations for eight guests are spread across four generous suites with the possibility of two more guests by converting the wellness suite into a fifth ensuite bedroom:

•⁠ ⁠Marble Ensuites: Each suite features sumptuous stone-clad bathrooms with premium finishes and walk-in showers.

•⁠ ⁠Outlook: Rooms overlook either the private terrace toward Hyde Park or tranquil internal garden courtyards.

Arrival & Exclusivity

•⁠ ⁠Private Entrance: Guests enjoy a dedicated entrance directly into the residence, ensuring a discreet arrival separate from the main building flow.

•⁠ ⁠Exclusive Access: Guests have full, private use of all amenities, including the gym, cinema, and the 1,000 sq ft terrace.
