locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Knightsbridge is one of London’s most prestigious and affluent neighborhoods, known for its luxurious lifestyle, elegant architecture, and proximity to iconic landmarks. Located in the heart of central London, it borders Hyde Park to the north and the upscale areas of Belgravia and South Kensington. Knightsbridge is synonymous with high-end living, offering a blend of history, culture, and modern sophistication.

The area is best known for Harrods, the world-famous luxury department store, which draws visitors from around the globe. It’s a mecca for high fashion, designer brands, gourmet foods, and exclusive products. In addition to Harrods, Harvey Nichols, another iconic department store, caters to those seeking cutting-edge fashion and beauty products. Knightsbridge's main thoroughfares, such as Brompton Road and Sloane Street, are lined with upscale boutiques, luxury jewelers, and flagship stores from global fashion houses, including Chanel, Louis Vuitton, and Gucci.

Despite its vibrant commercial areas, Knightsbridge retains a sense of privacy and tranquility. Elegant Georgian and Victorian townhouses, converted mansions, and modern luxury apartments define the residential areas, where discreet wealth is evident in the pristine streets and well-kept gardens. Properties in Knightsbridge are some of the most expensive in London, reflecting its exclusive nature and the high demand for prime real estate.

One of the neighborhood’s major highlights is its proximity to Hyde Park, one of London’s largest and most beloved green spaces. The park offers residents and visitors a scenic escape for leisurely strolls, picnics, boating on the Serpentine, or enjoying open-air concerts. Knightsbridge's location also places it close to Royal Albert Hall, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the Natural History Museum, providing easy access to culture and entertainment.

Knightsbridge is also renowned for its culinary scene. The area is home to some of London’s finest restaurants, including Michelin-starred establishments that offer world-class dining experiences. Whether seeking international cuisine or classic British fare, Knightsbridge offers a wide array of dining options that cater to the most discerning palates.

The area is well-connected, with the Knightsbridge Underground station providing easy access to the rest of London via the Piccadilly Line. Its central location allows residents and visitors to quickly reach key landmarks such as Buckingham Palace, Piccadilly Circus, and Covent Garden. Despite being in the heart of London, Knightsbridge offers a sense of exclusivity and escape from the city's busier, more commercialized areas.

Overall, Knightsbridge is a blend of old-world elegance and modern luxury, offering a lifestyle that appeals to those seeking the finest in culture, shopping, dining, and high-end living in one of London’s most distinguished neighborhoods

htmlDescription.htmlText:
This luxury 5-bedroom holiday let in Knightsbridge, near Harrods, combines elegance and modern comfort. Featuring an expansive living area with plush furnishings, a gourmet kitchen, and spacious bedrooms with en-suite marble bathrooms, it offers the perfect retreat. The master suite boasts a super king-sized bed and spa-like amenities. A private garden and secure garage add extra convenience, while its prime location offers access to top shopping, dining, and cultural attractions nearby.

The space
Experience the pinnacle of London luxury in this exceptional five-bedroom townhouse, perfectly positioned in the heart of Knightsbridge, moments from Harrods and Hyde Park. Spanning approximately 3,500 sq ft, the home blends classic elegance with modern comfort, offering an outstanding retreat for families, extended stays, or groups seeking privacy, space, and world-class amenities.

Grand Living & Entertaining Spaces
The expansive ground-floor living room is flooded with natural light and opens onto a private, fully fenced garden. Plush sofas, an indoor fireplace, and a 75-inch Smart TV with Netflix, Prime, Disney+, Apple TV and more create a warm and inviting atmosphere. A separate formal dining room features a striking marble dining table seating ten — ideal for hosting and family gatherings.

Gourmet Kitchen & Casual Dining
The fully equipped kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring:
Electric cooker with four hobs and stainless-steel oven
Nespresso, espresso machine, filter coffee maker, cafetière and pour-over
Blender, baking sheet, microwave, mini fridge, dishwasher
Premium cookware, cooking essentials, wine glasses and full tableware
A casual breakfast table and adjoining reception area offer the perfect spot for morning coffee.

Private Wellness Facilities
Unwind in your private in-home gym, fully equipped for daily workouts, or relax in the wood-panelled private sauna, seating up to five — a rare luxury in central London.

Five Luxurious Bedrooms
The townhouse comfortably accommodates larger groups with five beautifully appointed bedrooms:
Principal Suite (First Floor): Super king bed, walk-in wardrobe, and spa-style marble en-suite with walk-in shower and large bathtub
Bedroom Two (First Floor): Emperor bed with elegant dressing area
Bedrooms Three & Four (Second Floor): Each with super king bed, walk-in wardrobe, and private en-suite bathroom
Bedroom Five (Lower Ground): Super king bed and 75-inch TV
All bedrooms feature 500-thread-count Egyptian cotton linens, blackout blinds, generous storage, extra pillows and blankets, and air conditioning in four bedrooms to ensure exceptional comfort.

Family-Friendly & Thoughtfully Equipped
Ideal for families, the home includes:
Cot, travel cot, high chair, baby bath, changing table (on request)
Baby safety gates, plug socket covers and table corner guards
Children’s books, toys and tableware for multiple age groups
Babysitter recommendations available on request

Premium Amenities for Long & Short Stays
Central heating and air conditioning
High-speed Wi-Fi (100mbps+) and dedicated workspace
Washer, dryer, drying rack, iron and ironing board
Cleaning service available up to four days per week (additional cost)
Luggage drop-off before or after check-in
Free on-site parking and secure garage
Safe, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, fire extinguisher and first aid kit

The Neighbourhood
Set on a quiet, prestigious Knightsbridge street, the property is moments from Harrods, designer boutiques, fine dining, Hyde Park, and London’s most celebrated cultural attractions — combining tranquillity with exceptional centrality.

Long-Term Stays Welcome
The property is perfectly suited to extended visits, and stays of 28 days or longer are welcome, making it ideal for families relocating, long holidays, or executive stays.

Guest access
Guests will have exclusive and private access to the entire five-bedroom townhouse. This includes all interior living spaces, the serene private garden, the in-home gym, the private sauna, and a secure private garage for one vehicle.

Check-in is a seamless self-check-in process via a secure lockbox. Detailed instructions for access will be provided to you one week prior to your arrival date.

Other things to note
High-Speed Wi-Fi: Complimentary high-speed internet (100mbps+) is available throughout the home.

Laundry: An in-unit washing machine and dryer are available for your convenience.

Safety: The property is equipped with a first aid kit for minor needs. For your security, surveillance cameras are located on the exterior of the property only.

Housekeeping: Professional housekeeping services can be arranged during your stay for an additional cost. Please inquire for details.

Check-In: Detailed self-check-in instructions will be sent to you one week prior to your arrival.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Luxury Bushveld Self-Catering Cottage | Solar

Bathed in the warm glow of the African afternoon sun, this luxury self-catering cottage overlooks your private swimming pool and the breathtaking bushveld. Located within the exclusive Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate, in the charming town of Hoedspruit, it offers the perfect blend of comfort, and nature.
Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate has a strict no parties and no loud music policy to preserve the peaceful wildlife environment for all residents and guests.

The space
Spend your evenings on the patio with your favourite drink as you watch the spectacular African sunset over the bushveld. The cottage is nestled beneath magnificent indigenous trees, including Marula, Knob Thorn, and Leadwood, creating a peaceful and private setting.

The outdoor patio is perfect for alfresco dining or simply unwinding with a good book. During the day, relax on the sun loungers beside your private pool, and at night, gaze up at the breathtaking African sky filled with stars.

For a truly unforgettable experience, enjoy the outdoor shower while surrounded by the sights and sounds of the bushveld, with birdsong providing the perfect soundtrack.

Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate is home to an abundance of wildlife, including giraffe, zebra, impala, warthog, porcupine, duiker, leopard, and hyena. Many of these animals can be seen on game drives within the estate. Regular visitors to the cottage include duikers, warthogs, and playful vervet monkeys.

Bird lovers will be delighted by the incredible variety of birdlife, and each morning begins with a beautiful chorus of birdsong.

The cottage is fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable, self-catering stay. An information folder containing local maps, attractions, and useful recommendations is provided to help you make the most of your visit.

Guest access
The cottage is exclusively yours, offering complete privacy for up to 2 guests.

Inside, you'll find a spacious bedroom with a luxurious king-size bed draped in a mosquito net, a comfortable lounge, a fully equipped kitchen, and a large bathroom featuring both an indoor and an outdoor shower.

Outside, enjoy your own private patio with an outdoor dining area, a refreshing private swimming pool, and a private braai (barbecue) area—perfect for relaxing, dining under the stars, and making the most of the beautiful bushveld surroundings.

Other things to note
Arrival & House Rules

On the day of your arrival, you will receive a security access code for entry to Hoedspruit Wildlife Estate. I will personally meet you at Rooibos Luxury Bush Cottage to welcome you and show you around. We live on the property in our own separate lodge, so we're nearby if you need any assistance during your stay while still respecting your privacy.

Please Note: This is a peaceful wildlife estate with strict rules to protect its natural environment.

No parties are permitted.
No music may be played inside or outside the cottage.
Please enjoy the tranquillity of the bush—the birds and wildlife provide the only soundtrack you'll need.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Welcome to our brand-new, luxurious three-bed townhouse, nestled in a quiet street in the heart of London's Marylebone. This elegant space brings a sense of style and sophistication to your stay with ultra-modern fittings and tasteful decor. You'll find three well-appointed en-suite bedrooms equipped with super king and king-size beds, premium Egyptian cotton bed linen, and fluffy towels. All bedrooms feature air conditioning for that cool touch on warm summer days.

The space
The master bedroom features a luxurious UK super-king bed, perfect to unwind in after a day seeing the sights or strolling around nearby Regent's Park. Take a soak in the en-suite tub or enjoy a power shower; both are equally as enjoyable thanks to our premium botanical bathroom amenities. Spacious wardrobes mean you can really unpack your suitcases and settle into this stunning home-from-home.

The second and third bedrooms also enjoy individual en-suites with showers, for the ultimate privacy during your stay. The large second bedroom features a beautiful display of plants within an internal yard space, bringing a touch of the natural world into every room of the house.

Two living spaces ensure ample room for entertaining and relaxing. A reception greets you upon entering, with plush armchairs providing a great spot to read. Up the staircase, you'll find the spacious, open-plan living area. Enjoy a hearty dinner at the large six-seater dining table, or surf Netflix to your heart's content on the Smart TV from the cozy sofa. French doors open onto a balcony with furniture, for an alfresco morning coffee or evening glass of wine. A fully-equipped kitchen means you can easily prepare a home meal, if the numerous highly-rated restaurants nearby don't tempt you.

On-site parking is in the form of a small private garage, suitable for compact cars or estates/station wagons. Baker St tube station is a mere 6-minute stroll away, meaning all of London is within easy reach.

Depending on your personal preference, we can offer self-check-in, or you can be personally greeted by a member of the friendly Stay & Escape team, who will show you around the property and be able to answer any questions you might have. We will be at your disposal for the entire stay, should you require any advice or assistance. We also offer a 'Black Book' service where we can provide exclusive extras, such as airport transfers, welcome hampers, luxury transportation, grocery fridge-filling, and even VIP tickets to major events and the West End.

Guest access
You'll be able to enjoy the entire home in complete privacy and seclusion during your stay. Self-check-in is available for the ultimate discretion.

Other things to note
Complementary bathroom amenities, fresh fluffy towels, Wi-Fi, private secure parking and kitchen equipment are included in your stay.

Additional mid-stay cleaning is available at a price of £25 per hour, + £25 per bed change, as our linen is professionally cleaned off-site. Please let us know if you’d like to request this.

We offer fridge-filling, private chefs, airport transfers, and more. Rates are variable depending on timing and availability - please get in touch with us for more information.

Welcome to London. 

We open the doors to some of the city's most beautiful homes, set in its most exciting and coveted neighbourhoods. Each one has been chosen, and loved, before you ever arrive.

We hope you enjoy every moment here!

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Mayfair has long been London's most exclusive postcode, home to grand townhouses, private members' clubs, and some of the city's finest hotels.

This is one of its quietest corners, tree-lined and unhurried. Hyde Park is a short walk one way, Mount Street and Bond Street the other. You're in the centre of it all, yet none of it ever feels crowded.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
Bond Street and Marble Arch stations are both a short walk away, giving you the Underground and the Elizabeth line through to Heathrow within easy reach.

Taxis and ride shares are always close by, and most of the West End, the City, and London's main sights are within twenty minutes.

Parking is the one thing worth planning for. Mayfair is a residents only controlled parking zone, so street parking is not an option for visitors. The nearest car parks are at Park Lane and Cavendish Square, both walkable from the property. Please let us know if you will be driving and we will happily help you arrange this in advance.

Should you prefer a private chauffeur service for arrivals, departures, or for the duration of your stay, we are happy to arrange it for you.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Welcome to Knightsbridge, London's most sophisticated district, home to the city's embassies and diplomatic residences. It’s one of the most exclusive residential and retail districts in west London and, of course, home to the world-famous department store, Harrods. As well as shopping, Knightsbridge is renowned for its range of exclusive bars, restaurants, and clubs to suit all tastes and attracts the rich, the royal, and the celebrated from all over the globe.
Although virtually in the heart of the city, residential streets are often located in quiet, tree-lined squares, tucked away from the buzz and activity of Brompton Road and Sloane Street.

Particular highlights nearby include Harrods, Harvey Nichols, Hyde Park, the Victoria & Albert Museum, the Science Museum, and the Natural History Museum. Also, close by is Sloane Street, Sloane Square, the Saatchi Gallery, and King's Road.

The architecture is imposing and mostly early 19th-century red brick Queen Anne revival buildings or white stucco townhouses by Thomas Cubitt. Wander the streets, absorb the cosmopolitan atmosphere, and enjoy the shopping.

The surrounding area offers a wide range of upscale eateries, cafes, and bars to enjoy throughout your stay. Specific recommendations include Harry's Dolce Vita for authentic Italian dishes, Zuma for high-end Japanese cuisine, and Maroush for Lebanese delicacies.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
The closest Underground station is Knightsbridge, on the Picadilly Line (Blue Line) only a 2-minute walk from the property. This Line is well connected and offers access to all the main spots of London, such as Piccadilly Circus, South Kensington, Leicester Square, Covent gardens, Holborn, and more.

The second closest Underground station is Sloane Square, on the District and Circle Line (Green and Yellow) and gives access to all main stops in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Experience luxury living in one of London’s most prestigious neighbourhoods. Nestled on the charming Lowndes Street in the heart of Knightsbridge, this beautifully appointed 150m² townhouse offers the perfect blend of classic London elegance and modern comfort.

Set across three spacious floors with its own private entrance, the home provides exceptional privacy while placing you just moments from world-famous shopping, fine dining and London’s most iconic attractions.

The space
Designed with comfort and style in mind, the townhouse features three beautifully furnished bedrooms, each offering premium mattresses, luxurious hotel-quality linens and generous storage.

Bedroom 1 – Master Suite

* UK Super King Bed (180 × 200 cm)
* Private en-suite bathroom
* Spacious wardrobe
* Premium hotel-quality mattress and luxury linens

Bedroom 2

* UK King Bed (150 × 200 cm)
* Premium mattress
* Hotel-quality bedding

Bedroom 3

* UK King Bed (150 × 200 cm)
* Premium mattress
* Hotel-quality bedding

An additional single folding guest bed (90 × 190 cm) can be prepared upon request, allowing the townhouse to comfortably accommodate up to 7 guests.

The property also includes:

* Two modern bathrooms (one en-suite)
* Fully equipped kitchen
* Spacious living and dining area
* Central air conditioning throughout
* High-speed Wi-Fi
* Smart TV
* Washer & dryer
* Nespresso Machine
* Professionally cleaned before every stay

Prime Knightsbridge Location

Situated in one of London’s most exclusive neighbourhoods, everything is within easy walking distance.

Nearby attractions include:

* Harrods – 4-minute walk
* Harvey Nichols – 3-minute walk
* Hyde Park – 6-minute walk
* Sloane Street luxury boutiques – 3-minute walk
* Buckingham Palace – 20-minute walk
* Green Park – 15-minute walk
* Victoria & Albert Museum – 15-minute walk
* Natural History Museum – 18-minute walk
* Science Museum – 18-minute walk
* King’s Road, Chelsea – 15-minute walk

Transport

* Knightsbridge Underground Station (Piccadilly Line) – approximately 5-minute walk
* Hyde Park Corner Underground Station – approximately 10-minute walk
* Multiple London bus routes are available within a 2–3 minute walk, providing easy access to Westminster, Oxford Street, Mayfair, Kensington, Chelsea and the City.

Shopping & Essentials

Everything you need is just moments away, including:

* Waitrose & Partners
* Little Waitrose
* Sainsbury’s Local
* M&S Foodhall
* Local cafés, bakeries, restaurants, pharmacies and convenience stores

Whether you’re visiting London for shopping, business or sightseeing, this elegant townhouse offers the privacy of a home with the comfort of a luxury hotel, all in one of London’s most sought-after locations.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the whole property.

Other things to note
• Do you have free wifi? Yes. We will give you the wifi code when you check-in, it’s also written here on Airbnb on the Wi-Fi section and will show once you confirm the booking.

• Do you provide linen and towels? Yes, all fresh, pressed bed linen and big fluffy towels are provided!

* If you are a group of 8 guests you will need to select 8 guests when booking so we can set up the right sofa bed and add extra linen to have it ready for your stay, if you choose 6 guests we won’t be able to add extra linen and we can’t provide you with a sofa bed as the apartment is already set up for 6 people without sofa bed.

* There is extra charge of £150 per guest per night after 6 guests.

• Is there parking? We don’t offer parking

• Do you have Air con? Yes there is an AC central system throughout the whole property.

•Check ins from 10pm-2am incur £50 Extra charge.

** Please note we will check the passport of the person who booked upon arrived

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Pont Street sits at the heart of Knightsbridge — on the border of Chelsea and Kensington, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea — and is one of the most well-connected addresses in Central London. Sloane Street's luxury boutiques and Sloane Square are minutes away on foot, giving guests direct access to the finest shopping in the neighbourhood without the crowds of the Brompton Road. Chelsea's King's Road, the Saatchi Gallery, and the independent restaurants of Draycott Avenue and Walton Street are all easily accessible to the south.

Harrods is a moment's walk. Harvey Nichols, Beauchamp Place, and the restaurants of Brompton Road are all within minutes. Hyde Park is a short walk north. Three tube stations are within comfortable walking distance — Knightsbridge (Piccadilly line), South Kensington (District, Circle & Piccadilly), and Sloane Square (District & Circle) — giving guests exceptional connectivity across the city.

The South Kensington museum quarter and the Royal Albert Hall are approximately 15 minutes on foot or a single tube stop. Heathrow Airport is approximately 40 minutes via the Piccadilly line direct from Knightsbridge.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
Three tube stations are within comfortable walking distance, offering excellent connectivity across Central London.

Knightsbridge (Piccadilly line) — short walk. Direct to Green Park, Piccadilly Circus, King's Cross, and Heathrow Airport.
South Kensington (District, Circle & Piccadilly lines) — approx. 10-min walk.
Sloane Square (District & Circle lines) — approx. 10-min walk. Direct to Victoria Station.

By Tube:
— Heathrow Airport: approx. 40 min via Piccadilly line direct from Knightsbridge
— Victoria Station (Gatwick Express, National Rail): 10 min via District line from Sloane Square
— King's Cross St Pancras (Eurostar): 20 min via Piccadilly line from Knightsbridge
— Green Park / Mayfair: 2 stops via Piccadilly line
— Central London / West End: 10–15 min

EV charging: paid EV charging available on surrounding streets.
Parking: private underground parking at the Harrods car park, Basil Street, at £35 per day. Please request at the time of booking.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Rated 5% of homes globally. A beautifully designed Knightsbridge apartment on Pont Street SW1X, steps from Sloane Street, Chelsea, and Harrods, with an enchanting view over the private cobbled Pont Street Mews and St Saviour's Church.

King bedroom, king sofa bed, rainhead shower, Smart TV, and Harrods private parking available. Second floor, accessible by stairs, no step-free access. Sleeps 4.

The space
A beautifully designed one-bedroom apartment on the second floor of an elegant period building on Pont Street — one of Knightsbridge's most prestigious addresses, steps from Sloane Street's luxury boutiques, the King's Road, and Chelsea. The apartment is accessed via a communal entrance and stairs. There is no step-free access. Being on the second floor keeps the apartment pleasantly quiet and rewards guests with one of the most enchanting views available from any short-let property in Knightsbridge — looking out over the cobbled, private Pont Street Mews, the Victorian spire of St Saviour's Church, and the iconic Harrods building beyond.

Bedroom — A generous king bedroom with ample built-in storage and high-quality linen, designed for a genuinely restful stay.

Bathroom — A well-appointed bathroom with a rainhead double shower, heated towel rail, hotel-quality towels, hairdryer, shower amenities, bath mat, and shaving point.

Living area — A stylish open-plan lounge and kitchen with a Smart TV. A king sofa bed is always made up and ready to use, providing comfortable sleeping space for additional guests. Extra pillows and blankets provided.

Kitchen — Fully equipped for self-catering with hob, oven, microwave, fridge-freezer, dishwasher, kettle, toaster, coffee machine, and cooking utensils.

Workspace — A dedicated desk and fast Wi-Fi throughout.

Climate — Window air conditioning units and fans during the warmer months.

EV charging — Paid EV charging is available on the surrounding streets.

Parking — Private underground parking is available at the Harrods car park on Basil Street at £35 per day — please request at the time of booking.

Guest access
Guests have exclusive use of the entire apartment — the bedroom, bathroom, open-plan living and kitchen area. Nothing is shared with other guests.

The building is accessed via a communal entrance from Pont Street. The apartment is on the second floor, accessible by stairs. Once inside the apartment, everything is entirely private — your own front door, your own space.

Full arrival instructions and access details are sent ahead of check-in. A member of our team meets every guest at the property on arrival to hand over keys and ensure a smooth, comfortable start to your stay.

Private underground parking is available at the Harrods car park on Basil Street at £35 per day — please request this at the time of booking.

Other things to note
— The apartment is on the second floor, accessed via stairs from the communal building entrance. There is no step-free access.

— A noise decibel monitor is installed on the premises. It records sound levels only — no audio or video recording of any kind.

— Quiet hours apply between 21:00 and 09:00. Pont Street is a quiet residential conservation street and we ask all guests to be respectful of neighbours at all times.

— Private underground parking is available at the Harrods car park on Basil Street at £35 per day. Please request this at the time of booking.

— Paid EV charging is available on surrounding streets.

— Guests must be aged 26 or over. Exceptions are made for children under 18 accompanied by a parent or guardian who meets this requirement.

— The apartment is not suitable for parties or events. Maximum occupancy is 4 guests.

— This is a no-smoking property throughout.

— Pets are not permitted.

— Checkout by 10:00, check-in from 14:00. Early check-in or late checkout may be available on request — please message us in advance.

— Window air conditioning units and fans are fitted during the warmer months.

— The king sofa bed in the living room is always made up and ready to use. Extra pillows and blankets are provided.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Step into a haven of light and space in this extraordinary Covent Garden apartment. With two generously sized bedrooms and two luxurious bathrooms revealing a modern masterpiece designed for discerning travelers. The expansive living area, bathed in sunlight, just 2 mins walk from Covent Garden square.Every detail, from the sleek finishes to the open layout, has been carefully curated to create a bright, spacious, and truly unforgettable stay, the apartment is divided in 2 levels.

The space
The Space:

This exquisite apartment, nestled in the heart of Covent Garden Square, offers an unparalleled London experience. Bathed in natural light, the expansive living area features windows that frame breathtaking panoramic views of the bustling square below. Step onto the private rooftop terrace to truly immerse yourself in the vibrant energy of Covent Garden. The gourmet kitchen, fully equipped with state-of-the-art appliances, is perfect for culinary enthusiasts, while the luxurious bedrooms provide a tranquil retreat. This apartment is a sanctuary of sophistication and comfort, promising an unforgettable stay in London's cultural heart.

Living Room:

Elegant and stylish Furnishings: Relax in a space designed for refined living, featuring plush designer peninsula sofa bed , bespoke handcrafted furniture, and a curated selection of artwork. From street performers to the iconic market building, enjoy a captivating spectacle from the comfort of your living room.

Entertainment Hub: Unwind with a state-of-the-art entertainment system, including a 65" 4K Smart TV and a premium sound system.
Abundant Natural Light: the windows flood the living area with natural light, creating a bright and airy ambiance perfect for both relaxation and entertaining.

Master Bedroom:

King-Size Sanctuary: Retreat to a haven of tranquility with a luxurious king-size bed, dressed in Egyptian cotton linens and complemented by a selection of plush pillows.
Entertainment: Enjoy a relaxing evening in with the in room television.
Luxury Amenities: Pamper yourself with premium toiletries, ensuring a truly indulgent experience.
Stylish Furnishings: The room is furnished with x2 stylish bedside tables and lamps providing a warm and inviting atmosphere.
Ample Storage: A large wardrobe provides ample storage for your belongings

Bathroom:

A spacious walk-in shower, enclosed in frameless glass, offers a spa-like experience with a rainfall showerhead and adjustable body jets. The walls are clad in polished porcelain tiles, creating a sleek and luminous backdrop. A floating vanity unit, crafted from dark wood and topped with a sleek countertop, houses dual washbasins. The designer fixtures, finished in brushed brass, add a touch of understated luxury. Soft, ambient lighting illuminates the space, highlighting the meticulous attention to detail. Shower gel and shampoo are supplied in the house. A heated towel rail and plush, oversized towels complete the indulgent experience, ensuring a truly relaxing and rejuvenating retreat.

Double Bedroom En-Suite:

King size bed Comfort: Enjoy a restful night's sleep in a comfortable queen-size bed, fitted with high-quality linens and soft pillows.
Modern En-Suite: Refresh and rejuvenate in the contemporary en-suite bathroom, featuring a sleek colourful bath and stylish fixtures.
Designer Touches: The room is tastefully decorated with designer furniture and curated artwork, creating a sophisticated and inviting atmosphere.
City Views: Large windows offer pleasant views of the surrounding cityscape and Covent Garden.

Gourmet Kitchen:

Chef's Delight: Unleash your culinary creativity in a fully equipped gourmet kitchen, featuring top-of-the-line appliances and ample counter space.
State-of-the-Art Appliances: Enjoy the convenience of a built-in oven, induction hob, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, freezer, and wine cooler.
Premium Cookware and Utensils: Prepare delicious meals with high-quality cookware, utensils, and serving ware.
Nespresso Indulgence: Start your day with a perfect cup of coffee from the provided Nespresso machine, complete with a selection of capsules.
Dining Elegance: Gather around the elegant dining table, perfect for intimate meals or entertaining guests.
Key Features:

Arrive in style and convenience, our team will assist you at your arrival, providing access to the apartment floor,the apartment is located on the second floor then divided into 2 levels with nights area and day area upstairs.We offer in-person check-in to ensure a personal touch to your experience. Our team will be there to welcome you and assist with your luggage.

• Standard check-in: 3:00 pm – 10:00 pm
• Late check-in: After 10:00 pm, available upon request for a £50 fee (paid directly to the staff member assisting you)

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
It is all you need for luxurious living:

On Oxford street, you will find the best places to go shopping; you will surely get your money's worth from buying among the many products of beautiful shops. Walk along Oxford St and be inspired by West End, or venture into Bond Street , the fashionable Marylebone and the popular Fritzrovia area. One of the highlights is certainly the incredibly charming bohemian vibe in Soho, with hundreds of top restaurants , cafes , cinemas, theaters..

Along Tottenham Court Road you will find everything you need every day... from supermarkets to drugstores to boutiques, and stores selling the latest technological gadgets and trinkets.

Beautiful London attractions are comfortably in close proximity: From Covent Garden to Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus, River Thames, St Pancras, or the Regents Park. If you still want to use the tube - Tottenham Court Road Station is exactly 30 seconds away from your doorstep.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
2 tube stations are within 1-5 minutes walking distance:

-Oxford Circus
-Tottenham Court Road

5 - 8 minutes walk to:

Covent Garden
Leicester Square
Charing Cross
Goodge Street

Perfectly situated, this extraordinary apartment gives easy access to the best of London's West End. Fine dining in Soho, Mayfair, or Covent Garden, or eager to explore the city's fancy shops, famous theatres, and iconic museums, everything is just a stone's throw away.
The flat itself - single leveled with three beds and three baths is a masterpiece of design and comfort. With its spacious layout, plush furnishings, and state-of-the-art amenities, it feels like a home with a luxurious twist.

The space
Indulge in the unparalleled luxury of this extraordinary home, offering swift access to the iconic shopping districts of Oxford Street, Bond Street, and Regent Street, as well as the vibrant atmosphere of Soho and the entire London West End.

The expansive home boasts three elegantly designed bedrooms, including one slightly smaller room, complemented by three modern bathrooms and a spacious living area, ensuring ample comfort for all guests.

This 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom flat is fully equipped with a range of premium amenities, including:

Hotel style white towels
White hotel-style bed linen
Three hair dryers
High-quality toiletries
Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi
70-inch Smart TV
Apple TV
iPod speaker system
Coffee machine + Nespresso machine
Kettle, toaster, cooker, oven, fridge, microwave, blender, dishwasher, washer

Complete set of cutlery, pots, pans, and glasses
Guests will enjoy unlimited, fast, and stable Wi-Fi access throughout the apartment, ensuring a seamless and connected experience.

Guest access
The entire apartment with all amenities is accessible for my guests.
All closets are empty but full of hangers, you will find toiletries and hair dryers in the bathrooms. The kitchen is fully equipped with pots, pans, china, glasses and cutlery. Basics like tea, coffee, water, milk, capsules for the Nespresso Machine are provided to make sure your arrival will be relaxed. Detergents for washing machine and dish washer are provided for a stay of 3 nights. My stand - by guest manager will happily provide more supplies on request for small additional costs.

The apartment does have a fully functioning AC. However, during unusual hot hours, especially with direct sunlight into the living room, it may take longer to cool the space and cannot perform beyond its capacity.
We appreciate your understanding that in case of extreme weather conditions, a refund would not be applicable. 
 
Please keep the curtains closed during peak sun hours, as this helps a lot.
Let us know if there’s anything else we can assist with to make your stay more comfortable.

Other things to note
Let me arrange your airport pick-up and better explore London’s public transport without having luggage with you. I will personally welcome you at the property and will show you everything of importance.

I will happily answer your questions, just let me know how many sets of keys you need and I will provide them.

We are happy to provide a baby cot. Please bring your own baby linen accessories. Our Hotel linen provider does not offer any kind of baby cot linen.

For all smokers! The apartment has a dedicated small balcony, though it is neither a fancy place nor does it have a view

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Covent Garden is a vibrant and historic neighbourhood located in the heart of London's West End. Renowned for its rich cultural heritage, lively atmosphere, and diverse array of attractions, Covent Garden effortlessly blends old-world charm with contemporary flair, making it a favorite destination for locals and visitors alike.

At the heart of Covent Garden is its iconic piazza, a bustling square lined with elegant buildings, charming cafes, and street performers entertaining passersby. The area's history as a former fruit and vegetable market is still evident in the cobblestone streets and beautifully preserved architecture, adding to its unique character and charm.

Today, Covent Garden is a thriving hub of activity, offering an eclectic mix of shops, restaurants, theaters, and cultural institutions. From high-end boutiques and designer labels to artisanal markets and independent shops, there's something to suit every taste and budget. Food lovers will delight in the diverse dining options available, from Michelin-starred restaurants to cozy pubs and trendy eateries serving cuisine from around the world.

The neighborhood is also home to several world-class theaters, including the Royal Opera House and the Theatre Royal Drury Lane, where visitors can enjoy spectacular performances ranging from opera and ballet to musicals and plays. Art galleries, museums, and historic landmarks abound, providing endless opportunities for exploration and discovery.

Despite its bustling atmosphere, Covent Garden retains a sense of intimacy and charm, with hidden courtyards, narrow alleyways, and quiet squares waiting to be discovered. Whether you're strolling through the vibrant markets, catching a show in one of the historic theaters, or simply soaking up the atmosphere in a cozy cafe, Covent Garden offers a quintessentially London experience that is both timeless and unforgettable.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Opulence is the name of the game in Knightsbridge. This is London at its most grand and lavish: an area where many of your neighbours think nothing of picking up their daily groceries at Harrods and taking their dogs for a walk in Hyde Park before breakfast. Ideally located for exploring many of central London's key sights, Knightsbridge is also a mecca for high-end shopoholics.

At this amazing Belgravia house you really are spoilt for choice when it comes to food and drink both on your door step and a short walk away.
Below are a few local recommendations, however do not be shy to walk your way or jump a London Taxi to Kings Road which also offers a variety of restaurants and more.

Restaurants

Meat the Fish London
A simple, clean food approach is at the heart of the daily menu. Open for lunch and dinner they offer mediter-asian dishes feature seasonal, local produce with a good balance of meat, fish and plant-based specials.

Cote Sloane Square
Located right on the iconic square, they offer an exceptional menu brimming with everyones favourite French classics. Visit for breakfast, lunch or dinner in this stunning restaurant space, with stylish, contemporary decor reminiscent of the sleekest of Parisienne brasseries

Wild Tavern on Elystan Street
This Seafood restaurant offers a seasonal & carefully written menu and offers the culinary simplicity of the Mediterranean cuisine.

Restaurant Ours
A modern European Restaurant decorated with huge trees & had high ceilings to add drama to the restaurant. If offers the combo of both dining and drinks and perfect for socialising.

Coffee / Lunch & Brunch

Daylesford Organic
Cafe-deli with a chic vibe offering a menu of seasonal & organic plates & salads.

Ottolenghi on Pavillion Road
This deli stocks plenty of delicious products from the bakery, along with a selection of exciting low intervention wines - which can also be enjoyed as you eat in.

Cafe Volonte
A cosy and inviting haven where you can enjoy healthy and delicious food in the heart of London. The menu is designed to cater to all dietary needs and preferences, with a wide range of wholesome and nutritious options using the best locally-sourced, fresh and seasonal ingredients

Pub
The Chelsea Courtyard
The Admiral Codrington
Bunch of Grapes

Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located fantastic, spacious town house. Spread over three floors, with a living room, one spacious dining room, 3 bedrooms and patio this place is an ideal base for the whole family. Nested between Belgravia and Chelsea the house is in an ideal London location with plenty of attractions within a walking distance or few stations by tube.

The space
As you enter the home through the gated entrance and up a few steps, the first thing you will notice is the comfortable, modern but traditional living room with bookshelves and a TV for you to enjoy.
On the ground level you will also find the first bedroom which features a cosy arrangement with two single beds. This room offers comfort and convenience.

Down the stairs in the basement you will find the dining area with elegant furnishings, a polished dining table and comfortable chairs. This room features tasteful decor elements such as the artwork and a wooden beamed ceiling enhance the overall dining experience.
Opposite the dining area you will be greeted by the modern kitchen and utility area. The kitchen is equipped with appliances, a variety of utensils and plenty of space for you to prepare for your family or friends.

The second guest bedroom is also located in the basement, decorated in the modern yet traditional way with neutral colours and wooden furnishings and featuring a king size bed. Within this second bedroom is an en-suit with both toilet, sink and shower.

Back up the stairs and up to the first floor is the bright and airy master bedroom flooded with natural light, creating a refreshing and spacious atmosphere. The room features a comfortable super king-size bed and again that tasteful yet minimalist decor.
Along with the master bedroom upstairs is the large shared bathroom designed for comfort and luxury. It includes a stylish bathtub, toilet and sink with ample room to move around. The neutral colour scheme contributes to a serene and inviting ambience making it the ideal place to relax.

Lastly is the garden patio/small courtyard which offers a charming outdoor space to watch the world go by after a long day sightseeing and shopping in the glorious London.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Stunning mews house in Primrose Hill, London. Uniquely stylish with a sunny walled garden. Located on a tiny cobble stoned street, a few steps away from Primrose Hill Park and the wonderful local shops and cafes. Our home is often booked privately by movie actors who love the comfort and the creative style The house has artistic & personal items in it which we hope will add charm to your stay.
We have A/C in the primary bedroom & kitchen/dining area- quite an unusual feature in London.

The space
Relaxed and comfortable Morocco meets India meets Paris with an urban industrial blend. The kitchen with its rustic concrete floor has two ovens, a modern electric AGA stove and a conventional fan oven. We love our vintage over sized copper sink with an instant boiling filtered water tap. The romantic primary suite offers a super-king size bed, a Victorian bath and a steam shower. The second bedroom also has an ensuite bathroom. At night, the house feels calm with amber and orange lighting- creating a golden candle like ambience. Our home romantic and comfortable, shabby chic some may say. We say imperfectly perfect. We hope you’ll love our home as much as we do.

Guest access
The house has two storeys. Entrance on the ground floor. The open plan living space is on the ground floor with access straight to the garden. The primary suite and the second bedroom & bathrooms are located one flight up. We have a parking space available to us most of the time, if you require this, please message me before you book and I’ll see if we can make this available for you. Also, if your dates are unavailable, or the length of stay doesn’t suit please message me and we will see if we can accommodate you.

Other things to note
The air conditioning is in the kitchen/dinning area and the primary bedroom. The other rooms have ceiling fans and portable fans. The third bedroom is petite and beautiful. The master bedroom has a super-king size bed and the second bedroom has a king size bed. We also have a full size foldable table tennis table in the garden. Let us know if you’d like this available to you. One of us will be there at check in to advise and to show you how the appliances work. Extra cleaning is included in the fee if desired. (Monday or Thursday).
The house welcomes children - but the stairs have a rope handrail only on one side which only and is not really suitable for toddlers. We can organise a safety gate for the stairs for longer stays if needed.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
PRIVATE SOUTH KENSINGTON RETREAT - DESIGNED FOR DISCERNING FAMILIES

Discover exceptional privacy and comfort in this modern four-bedroom house, in a totally quiet, leafy gated-mews in South Ken - one of London’s most prestigious and culturally rich neighborhoods...steps away from world-renowned museums, award-winning restaurants, great shopping, and 'little France'...with its cafes, bakeries, and the Lycée & Institut Francais. This is your family's ideal private sanctuary within vibrant London.

The space
WHERE COMFORT MAKES MEMORIES

Step inside this home designed for good living. Bathed in natural light and across multiple spacious levels, this residence offers unusually generous interiors, curated for fun entertaining, for sharing a joke, and for quiet moments of repose. All top quality beds and bedding aim to provide your family the deepest, most ahhhh-some sleep anywhere!

Your home is air-conditioned - a rare but valuable feature in today's London - to ensure your perfect comfort in all seasons.

Whether you're hosting or unwinding, the expansive rooftop terrace is a standout feature. It includes a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with a BBQ, plush lounge seating — ideal for alfresco dinners, sharing a joke or a drink, or tranquil yoga sessions. Three additional terraces invite sun-lounging, playing cards or chess, and for kids to have great fun, in the open air.

CURATED INTERIORS & THOUGHTFUL COMFORT

A sunlit open-plan living/dining space with bespoke furnishings

A chef’s kitchen with premium appliances, perfect for everything from light brunches to gourmet meals

A luxurious master suite with a striking cathedral ceiling and spa-style en-suite bathroom

Curated beds, ultra-premium mattresses, and Egyptian cotton bedding and towels for a truly restorative sleep

Professional-grade air filtration and whole-house water softening system

For music lovers, a quality piano awaits your personal expression.

WELLNESS & WORK, SEAMLESSLY INTEGRATED

You’ll also enjoy exclusive access to a wellness space with gym equipment, weights, a Peloton bike and yoga mats.

Need to work during your stay? The house includes three dedicated workstations and fast Wi-Fi throughout. A printer is available for your convenience.

Housekeeping is provided three times a week, so you can enjoy a hassle-free stay and focus entirely on relaxation, exploration, or productivity.

A private garage could be made available for guests. Will fit a small/medium-sized car. Please inform us at the time of booking if you require the garage.

PERSONALISED SERVICE TO ELEVATE YOUR STAY

As your hosts, we're always happy to assist in making your time in our home and in London as enjoyable as possible. If you need help with any of the following, simply let us know in advance:

Babysitting
Private tour guides
Best restaurants
Drivers or airport transfers
Local events and what's on in London
Kids' clubs, family activities, and attractions
Best Spas and wellness experiences
Exclusive experiences like helicopter sightseeing tours
Prime South Kensington Location

Our neighbourhood offers charm, safety, and exceptional access to the best of London:

Artisan bakeries, French and other cafes,, and international cuisine within 5 minutes’ walk

Waitrose (Whole Foods like), and local markets for convenient grocery options

Iconic pubs and chic wine bars around the corner

Lamborghinis on display at the local showroom — just in case.

You are minutes from the Victoria&Albert Museum (biggest fine arts collection on earth), the Natural History Museum where T-Rex awaits, the Royal Albert Hall, and Hyde Park, for running, watching the Household Cavalry, or rowing your boat. And.. with South Kensington Station only 3 minutes’ walk, all of London is within your easy reach.

DISTANCES ON FOOT

South Kensington Station – 3 minutes

V&A and Natural History Museum - 6 minutes

'Little France' and dozen restaurants - 5 minutes

Hyde Park – 14 minutes

Royal Albert Hall – 13 minutes

Harrods – 20 minutes walk, or 1tube stop, 4 min.

King’s Road, buzzing – 12 minutes

Buckingham Place -25 minutes, or 2 tube stops 8 min.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Located in the heart of central London, this elegant two-bedroom, two-bathroom townhouse offers 1,250 sq ft of refined living space. After a day exploring the city, relax in the comfortable living area or cook in the fully equipped kitchen. Both bedrooms feature super king beds and stylish en-suite bathrooms. Just moments from Hyde Park, Oxford Street, and Selfridges, it’s an ideal base for experiencing London at its best

Additional ID may be required

The space
✨ Modern Marylebone Townhouse • 2BR/2BA • Super King Suites

Located in the heart of central London, this beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse offers 1,250 sq ft of bright, stylish living space. Perfect for families, couples, and business travellers, the home blends comfort, privacy, and convenience—just moments from Hyde Park, Oxford Street, Selfridges, and major transport links.

🛋️ Relaxing Living Spaces

Unwind in the cosy living room with plush seating and a 75-inch Smart TV with Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and AppleTV. The adjoining dining area features a marble table for four—ideal for meals prepared in the fully equipped kitchen.

🍽️ Fully Equipped Kitchen

The modern kitchen includes:

Full gas range & oven

Microwave & dishwasher

Nespresso machine with complimentary pods

Cookware, dinnerware, oils & spices

Everything you need for casual breakfasts or home-cooked dinners is at your fingertips.

🛏️ Two Private Super King Suites

Each spacious bedroom sits on its own floor for enhanced privacy and features:

Super King bed with 600-thread-count Egyptian cotton sheets

Blackout curtains for restful sleep

Built-in wardrobes & full-length mirrors

A dedicated workspace in the primary suite

A private en-suite bathroom:

One with a high-pressure walk-in shower

One with a relaxing bathtub/shower combo
Both bathrooms include marble flooring, heated towel rails, and Aesop toiletries.

👶 Family-Friendly Amenities

Thoughtfully equipped for families, including:

Crib

High chair

Children’s books & toys

Stair gates

Baby bath

Child-safe tableware

💼 Practical Comforts

High-speed Wi-Fi (100 Mbps+)

In-unit washer & dryer

Portable air-conditioning units

Private entryway and total exclusive access

📍 Prime Marylebone Location

Enjoy the charm of a quiet residential street in one of London’s most desirable neighbourhoods, with top restaurants, cafés, shops, and parks just minutes away. Walk easily to Hyde Park, Oxford Street, and Selfridges, or hop on the nearby Tube for quick access across the city.

📝 Other Things to Note

The home spans three floors; stairs are required to access bedrooms.

Sole access to the entire property ensures complete privacy.

🌟 Your London Stay Awaits

With its central location, premium comforts, and family-friendly features, this Marylebone townhouse offers the perfect home base for an unforgettable London stay. We look forward to welcoming you.

Guest access
Guests will have sole, private access to the entire townhouse. This includes all living areas, both bedrooms, both bathrooms, and the kitchen.

Key access features include:
Private entryway
Convenient self check-in via a secure lockbox
Luggage drop-off is permitted if you arrive before check-in time.

Other things to note
We strive to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Please note the following:
The home is situated across three floors. The bedrooms are located on the second and third floors, and access requires climbing stairs. This may not be suitable for guests with mobility concerns.
High-speed Wi-Fi (100 Mbps+) is available throughout the home.
An in-unit washer and dryer are provided for your convenience.
Portable air-conditioning units are available.

For families, we are thoughtfully equipped with:
Crib and high chair
Children’s books and toys
Baby bath
Child-safe tableware

Additional ID checks may be required

htmlDescription.htmlText:
La Casa Bianca is a newly built villa in the peaceful Biteng Maetur area. Known for its calm atmosphere and friendly community, Biteng offers easy access to the main attractions of Yaoundé. The villa is steps from Complex Foe and the Minister of Defence’s residence, making the area very secure. A friendly on-site guardian is available 24/7 to assist you throughout your stay.

The space
La Casa Bianca offers very spacious rooms and common areas, providing a quiet, clean and safe place to relax. Our on-site guardian is available 24/7 to make you feel at home. The villa is ideal for families and groups, and suitable for meetings, small events, gala evenings or video shoots.

Guest access
La Casa Bianca Biteng is a spacious residence with 7 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Two bedrooms include private bathrooms and walk-in wardrobes, while the master bedroom features a private jacuzzi bathroom and walk-in wardrobe (available for an additional fee).
On the second floor, there is a shared bathroom with a jacuzzi.
The property also offers a terrace on every floor, a double living room, a dining room, and a fully equipped kitchen.

Other things to note
We also provide a housekeeper for daily cleaning of the entire property and bed linens. The housekeeper can also take care of laundry and cooking, depending on the guests’ needs. These additional services can be arranged directly with the guests.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Spanning across three levels, A Space Residence is a domestic gallery, occasionally available as a guest house for selective stays.

Ideal for couples or singles for a relaxing and tranquil time, the space is inspired by Japanese spacial sensibility and is designed with attention to detail and love for materials.

Central location (minutes to Kings Cross) makes it a convenient stay with easy access to the best of London.

The space
Enter the guest house through a private entrance and arrive in a serene, open foyer, thoughtfully designed with a handcrafted bench and a generous walk-in wardrobe offering ample storage for your belongings.

The home unfolds across multiple levels, creating a unique spatial journey. A pair of steps on your left leads to the living area, while a staircase on the right descends to the kitchen level below.

The living room is a bright, minimalist retreat inspired by contemporary Japanese aesthetics. Warm oak panelling, carefully crafted joinery, and bespoke details create a calming atmosphere. At its centre, a tatami platform invites moments of quiet reflection, tea, reading, or relaxation, while a dedicated workspace provides a comfortable setting for remote work.

Going up the staircase, you'll discover a private and tranquil bedroom suite. This peaceful sanctuary features a double bed, a freestanding bathtub, integrated closet, and a private toilet, blending comfort with understated luxury.

Down on the lower level you'll find a fully equipped kitchen, fitted with solid walnut cabinetry, marble worktops and backsplash, and elegant brass hardware. This level also includes a private sauna, a shower room, and a second toilet.

Throughout the guest house, triple-glazed windows ensure exceptional quiet and comfort. Natural materials, including oak, walnut, stone, and tatami, create a warm and tactile environment, while handmade details and carefully curated objects lend the space its distinctive character. Designed with a deep appreciation for simplicity, craftsmanship, and contemporary Japanese living, the house offers a peaceful retreat unlike any other.

Guest access
Guests get a full access to all three levels of the property with all its amenities – bedroom suite with a freestanding bathtub, dedicated workspace in a spacious living room, fully equipped kitchen, shower room, and a sauna.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Notting Hill is a prestigious and affluent neighbourhood located in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea in West London. It is known for its opulent homes, stunning gardens, and a sense of elegance.
Lined with grand, stately, and often historic houses. Many of these properties are beautiful examples of Victorian and Edwardian architecture, characterised by ornate facades, large windows, and wrought-iron gates. Some have been converted into luxurious apartments, while others remain as impressive single-family homes. The tree-lined streets create a serene and green environment. The area is beautifully landscaped, and many houses have private gardens that are meticulously maintained. Known for its privacy and security. It's a sought-after area for both residents and celebrities who appreciate the tranquility and discretion it offers. Close to some of London's most beautiful green spaces. Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park are within walking distance, providing opportunities for leisurely strolls, picnics, and outdoor activities.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
London Underground (Tube): The nearest Tube stations to Kensington Park Gardens are Notting Hill Gate (Central, Circle, and District lines)
London has an extensive bus network, and there are several bus stops in and around Kensington Park Gardens. You can use buses to reach destinations that may not be easily accessible by the Tube.
Kensington is a lovely area for walking, and many local amenities, shops, and restaurants are within walking distance. Explore the nearby parks, such as Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park, on foot.
London has a growing network of cycling lanes and bike-sharing schemes. You can cycle around the area or use cycling lanes to reach other parts of the city.
You can access overground train services from stations like Kensington (Olympia), which can connect you to other parts of London and beyond.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Step into my massive Penthouse style Home just moments from the pulse of the River Thames and Westminster.
My home is designed for those who appreciate the art of living well. Sunlit spaces, modern furniture, everything carefully set up for travellers seeking for an atmospheric home. Gather with family, host friends, or enjoy a refined base for business. The Penthouse is a space to connect, retreat, and recharge.
Experience the city in a unique rhythm — vibrant by day, serene by night.

The space
I am proud to present my beautifully designed three-bedroom, three-bathroom residence which offers generous proportions in effortless comfort.

Anchored by a spacious open-plan living area with a modern, fully equipped kitchen . An ideal situation for entertaining guests or family - or relaxing in style.

Floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light, creating an airy, refined atmosphere throughout the day. Step out onto the private terrace to enjoy a quiet moment or unwind after exploring the city.

Despite its tranquil riverside setting, the apartment is perfectly connected — just five minutes by tube from Piccadilly Circus — offering the rare balance of calm, space, and central London convenience.

A bright, elegant retreat designed for those who appreciate light, location, and room to truly settle in.

Location & Getting Around

St George Wharf is a prime riverside location with excellent transport links, making it easy to explore London while enjoying a peaceful setting by the Thames.

Vauxhall Station is jon your doorstep and provides access to the Victoria Line, one of London’s fastest Underground lines. From here, you can reach Piccadilly Circus, Oxford Circus, Victoria, and King’s Cross quickly and easily.

innumerous bus routes operate from here , providing convenient access to central London and surrounding neighborhoods.

For a more scenic option, Thames UBER river boats run from nearby piers, offering a relaxing way to travel through the city.

Taxis and ride-hailing services such as Uber are readily available in the area.

Despite being so well connected, St George Wharf maintains a calm, residential feel — offering the perfect balance between central convenience and riverside tranquility.

Guest access
My apartment features a fully equipped, modern kitchen, thoughtfully designed for guests who enjoy cooking and dining at home. You’ll find a complete set of pots, pans, cutlery, crockery, glassware, and cooking utensils, making meal preparation easy and enjoyable. The kitchen flows seamlessly into a comfortable dining area, ideal for relaxed breakfasts, family dinners, or entertaining.

To help you settle in from the moment you arrive, we provide a starter supply of essentials, including salt and pepper, tea bags, coffee, Nespresso capsules, and sugar sachets.

Should you need any additional supplies during your stay, our standby guest manager is always happy to assist and can arrange top-ups upon request for a small additional charge.

Other things to note
Check-in and check-out times are flexible when possible, just let me know in advance, and i'll do my best to accommodate!

Bulthaup kitchen with premium appliances, quality cookware, filtered water, and extras like a juicer and blender. Perfect for relaxed evenings in after shopping at Daylesford or Prezzemolo e Vitale.

The recently updated Phoenix is the closest pub, located at the foot of our mews, a 90 second walk.

The northwest gate of Hyde Park is just a 2 minute walk away - ideal for a morning jog, or tea at the Kensington Palace Orangery.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Refurbished to the highest standard, this elegant 1-bed flat blends Victorian charm with modern design, featuring high ceilings, chic furnishings, fully equipped kitchen, a cozy sofa bed, and a private balcony with tree-lined views.

Ideally situated near Kensington’s top attractions, including Kensington Gardens, the V&A, and Hyde Park, this flat is also a short walk from the Circle, Piccadilly, and District tube lines, offering seamless access to the city and highlights nearby.

The space
This charming Victorian flat blends timeless elegance with modern comforts, making it the perfect stay for you in London. This thoughtfully designed space offers:

Living and Dining Area
The bright, open-plan living and dining area exudes character, featuring high ceilings, ornate moldings, and large bay windows that fill the space with natural light. Relax on the luxurious velvet sofa, which conveniently converts into a comfortable double bed, allowing the flat to accommodate additional guests. Enjoy your favorite shows on the flat-screen TV or admire the beautifully restored, decorative fireplace – a charming nod to the home’s Victorian heritage. The dining table, set near the windows, seats four and is ideal for enjoying meals while taking in the picturesque view of the surrounding street.

Modern Kitchen
The fully equipped kitchen is both functional and sleek, featuring marble countertops, an integrated oven, a stovetop, and ample storage. Essentials like cookware, dishes, and a coffee machine are provided, making it ideal for preparing meals or enjoying a morning coffee.

If cooking isn't on your agenda, the neighborhood boasts a fantastic selection of eateries and traditional pubs just a short stroll away, offering plenty of tempting options.

Bedroom
The serene bedroom offers a king-sized bed with comfortable linens, overhead storage cabinets, and ambient lighting. It’s a quiet and comfortable retreat after a day of exploring the city.

Bathrooms
There are two immaculate bathrooms:
A primary bathroom with a bathtub, walk-in shower, and contemporary brass fittings.
A secondary bathroom with a walk-in shower and elegant fixtures. Both feature heated towel rails and are stocked with fresh towels and toiletries.

Balcony
Step out onto the private balcony and soak in the picturesque views of the tree-lined street, a lovely spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

Additional Features:

- High-speed Wi-Fi throughout.
- Ample wardrobe space for longer stays.

This flat is ideally located, with easy access to nearby shops, cafes, and public transportation. Whether you’re visiting for leisure or business, this flat provides the perfect mix of comfort, style, and convenience.

Note: This flat is in a charming 200+ year-old period building, which comes with character—along with more typical London ambient noise than a modern new-build. If you’re sensitive to sound, earplugs can be a helpful addition.

Guest access
You may enjoy full access to the property.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Located directly opposite (across the road from) Buckingham Palace, in the upmarket & highly sought-after St James’s Park (Westminster).

Zone 1, super central London location - fabulous for walking to major attractions, shops, restaurants etc.

2-5 mins walk to London’s most picturesque Royal Parks:

- St James Park - , home to Englands only Pink Pelicans, and friendly Parakeets. Great kids play area and lots of wildlife which is entertaining for kids!)

- Green Park: Cross the palace to reach the luscious green park, stroll by the Ritz or Fortnum and Mason for afternoon tea.

LOADS of great restaurants, cafes, delis, bars etc very close by. Prior to check in i will provide a map of local spots which is helpful.

The neighbourhood is extremely safe and secure. Proximity to the palace means the area is very safe to walk around at all times!

Walking distance to major London attractions, 10-20 mins to the below:

- Trafalgar Square
- Whitechapel
- 10 Downing Street
- The Big Ben
- Westminster abbey
- London eye
- Piccadilly Circus / Leicester Sq
- St James Palace etc.
- Soho & The west-end
- Knightsbridge & Belgravia

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
The most central point in London, you can walk to most places:
- Mayfair - 10mins
- Westminster Bridge (Big Ben) - 15 mins
- Belgravia - 15 mins
- Soho - 25 mins
- Covent Garden - 25 mins
- Major landmarks, Big Ben, Downing Street, Piccadilly Circus etc - within 15 mins

Super close access to tube and trains:
- Victoria Station - 5 mins (direct train to gatwick, 45mins)
- St James Park Tube - 5 mins
- Green Park Tube - 5 mins (direct train to heathrow, 45mins)

Local amenities:
- M&S food - 2-3 mins walk
- Waitrose - 5 minute walk
- Restaurant and bars - 5 mins
- Local bakery - 5 mins

Parking:

- On street parking is available via the RingGo app (although be mindful that the area is very busy with lots of road closures due to the jubilee, so parking is not guaranteed).

- Free secure garage parking may be available if not in use (ask in advance of booking and i'll let you know!)

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Eclectic, vibrant, and brimming with character, Camden Town is one of London’s most iconic and culturally rich neighbourhoods. Famed for its alternative spirit, Camden offers a unique blend of historic charm and modern edge. The area is a haven for creatives and music lovers, with legendary venues like the Roundhouse and Electric Ballroom just a stroll away.

By day, explore the bustling Camden Market, where street food stalls, vintage treasures, and independent boutiques line the canalside. By night, the atmosphere comes alive with live music, buzzing pubs, and atmospheric bars. For those who crave green space, the expansive Regent’s Park and the panoramic views from Primrose Hill are just minutes away. Camden Town is perfect for those who want to immerse themselves in London’s bold, artistic energy while staying well connected to the rest of the city.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
Camden Town is one of the most well-connected areas in London, with a range of transport modes to choose from.

Camden Town Underground Station is served by the Northern line with direct connections to major rail stations King's Cross St Pancras International, Euston, Waterloo, London Bridge, Moorgate and Charing Cross. Battersea Power Station and Tottenham Court Road are key tourist destinations for shopping and the theatre, and Bank for access to the city's financial district.

Camden Road Overground Station is served by the Mildmay line, unlocking access to more rural London locations, such as Kew Gardens and Richmond.

For those preferring to stay above ground, there are direct bus connections right outside the building and nearby, serving A range of Zone 1 locations, Paddington, the City and Islington.

Other things to note
Please note that the apartment is not safe for infants. It has a steep wooden staircase in the centre of the space without gates, large heavy mirrors, and a heavy sliding glass door.

Because of these, I cannot accept bookings from people with children under the age of 14.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Knightsbridge is a prestigious and affluent area in central London, renowned for its elegance, exclusivity, and world-class offerings. This iconic neighborhood, nestled between Hyde Park and the bustling districts of Chelsea and Belgravia, epitomizes luxury living and is a magnet for discerning visitors and residents alike.

Key Highlights of Knightsbridge:

World-Class Shopping: Knightsbridge is synonymous with luxury shopping. At its heart lies the legendary Harrods, a department store that is a destination in itself, offering an unparalleled selection of designer brands, gourmet foods, and opulent interiors. Nearby, Harvey Nichols provides another upscale shopping experience, catering to fashion-forward clientele with its curated selection of high-end fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products.

Fine Dining and Cafés: The culinary scene in Knightsbridge is nothing short of spectacular. The area boasts a myriad of fine dining establishments, including Michelin-starred restaurants such as Dinner by Heston Blumenthal and Marcus. Elegant cafés and charming patisseries line the streets, offering delightful spots for a leisurely coffee or afternoon tea.

Cultural Landmarks: Knightsbridge is home to several cultural and historical landmarks. The Victoria and Albert Museum, with its extensive collection of art and design, and the Natural History Museum, known for its stunning architecture and fascinating exhibits, are just a short walk away. The area also features beautiful historical architecture, including grand townhouses and embassies.

Green Spaces: Despite its urban setting, Knightsbridge offers serene green spaces. Hyde Park, one of London's largest and most famous parks, is adjacent to the area, providing a peaceful retreat with its picturesque walking paths, boating lake, and seasonal events. The park is perfect for a morning jog, a relaxing stroll, or a picnic on sunny days.

Exclusive Real Estate: Knightsbridge is renowned for its exclusive real estate, featuring some of the most coveted addresses in London. From elegant Georgian and Victorian townhouses to modern luxury apartments, the properties in this area offer unparalleled quality and sophistication.

Convenient Transport Links: The area is well-served by public transport, with Knightsbridge and Sloane Square tube stations providing easy access to the rest of London. Major bus routes also traverse the neighborhood, making it convenient for exploring the city's attractions.

Knightsbridge is not just a place to visit; it’s a lifestyle. Its blend of luxury, culture, and convenience makes it a unique and desirable destination for those seeking the best that London has to offer. Whether you are drawn by its high-end shopping, exquisite dining, or cultural landmarks, Knightsbridge promises an unforgettable experience.

htmlDescription.htmlText:
Stylish stay in a brand new luxury home.

Welcome to your perfect London retreat! Nestled just moments from the iconic Battersea Power Station, and 5 minutes walk from the beautiful Battersea Park, this stylish and comfortable home offers the ideal base to explore the city. With its vibrant restaurants, boutique shopping, and exciting events, you’ll be at the heart of one of London’s trendiest areas.

The space
Luxury in Battersea; this interior designed London home is perfect for proximity to the city and all it has to offer, whilst offering the peace and quiet of a residential area 5 minutes walk from the beautiful Battersea Park.

Fully refurbished in 2024 to offer a high-end stay just moments from Battersea Power Station, it offers brand-new interiors, sleek design, and premium amenities for the discerning traveller.

🏡 The Space

✔ Three Spacious Bedrooms – Thoughtfully designed for comfort:

Master Bedroom – A serene sanctuary with a plush king-size bed and en-suite luxury bathroom with roll top bathtub.
Guest Bedroom 1 – Bright and airy with a double bed, garden views and stylish decor.
Guest Bedroom 2 – A cozy and versatile space with a double bed, perfect for extra guests or children.
(A 3rd basement bedroom is available on request and at an additional cost.)

✔ Modern Open-Plan Living – A beautifully designed living, dining, and kitchen area with elegant furnishings, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, large Smart TV and bio fire.

✔ Brand-New Kitchen – Fully equipped with high-end Miele double stack ovens, induction hob, sleek quartz countertops, and everything you need to cook and dine in style.

✔ Luxury Bathrooms – Featuring spa-like rainfall showers, modern tiling, and premium fittings for a hotel-like experience.

✔ Private Gym & Utility Room – Stay active with a dedicated workout space, plus a utility room with washer/dryer for convenience.

✔ Landscaped Garden – A beautifully designed outdoor space, ideal for morning coffee or evening drinks, Green Egg BBQ and outdoor kitchen with sink.

🌆 The Location

Located just a short walk from Battersea Power Station, this home places you in one of London’s most exciting neighborhoods, offering:

✔ Restaurants & Bars – From rooftop cocktails to gourmet brunch spots.
✔ Boutique Shopping & Entertainment – Explore the Power Station’s shopping and cinema.
✔ Easy Transport Links – The Northern Line is nearby, giving fast access to central London.
✔ Scenic Walks & Attractions – Enjoy the Thames riverside or Battersea Park, or stroll over the river to the famous Kings Road.

This is the perfect blend of modern luxury and unbeatable location.

Guest access
A personal welcome as you check in and when you leave is part of the service, so we can answer any questions you have.

Other things to note
We provide a weekly cleaning service to help keep everything in perfect order.

I'm afraid we cannot accommodate pets, and have a strict no smoking or parties policy.

locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
Little Venice is located adjacent to the fabulous mega transport hub of Paddington Station in central London W2 (west central) and yet itself remains a quiet, beautiful, high class neighbourhood, full of charm, famed for its canals and attractive, stucco-fronted houses. It is often referred to as an “oasis of calm” and “a hidden gem”.

It is a tourist destination in its own right and is nestled between Notting Hill Gate (West), Regents Park and Primrose Hill (East) , Hyde Park (South) and St John’s Wood/Primrose Hill (North).

The picturesque neighbourhood is centred around the more traditional Brownings Pool and the Regents and Paddington canals, with their colourful moored narrowboats hosting cafes, restaurants and bars and the new Paddington Basin development situated between Brownings Pool and Paddington Station where you will find supermarkets and further restaurants and bars.

There are three underground/metro stations- Paddington Station a 6 minute walk straight down the canal path and there is also Warwick Avenue and Royal Oak stations within a 5-7 minute walk.

There is also canal boat transport travelling from Brownings Pool, Little Venice to Regents Park Zoo & Camden Market.

Plus bus stops near Paddington end for the hop on hop off bus.


.

locationDescriptions.title: Getting around
locationDescriptions.content:
There are three tube stations in close proximity to the apartment:-

1. Warwick Avenue Tube (Bakerloo Line) this is a nice quiet station on a pretty street and is a 5-6 minute walk from the apartment. The Bakerloo Line is good for central London - Oxford Street (7 minutes) , Trafalagar Square (Charing Cross), The South Bank (14 minutes) (Embankment or Waterloo).

2. Paddington Station is a pleasant 5-6 minute walk straight down the Regents canal path and enter through the side rear.
This a mainline railway station good for journeys out of London like to the Cotswolds or Bath. It is also home to the Heathrow Express (non stop 15 minute train to Heathrow Airport). It also has multiple tube lines including the new Elizebeth Line (Like the central line but faster and newer), Bakerloo Line, District and Circle Line , Hammersmith and City Line).

3. Royal Oak. It is a not very pleasant 6 minute walk along the busy Harrow Road. Has the Circle Line and also the Hammersmith and City Line. (Three stops to White City and Westfield Mall the biggest in London.

Canal Boat
You can catch a canal boat from Little Venice the lake/pond at the end of your street to Regents Park and Regents Park zoo (1st stop) and Camden Town and it’s market best on weekends (2nd stop).

Uber
If you have the app - car will arrive within 2-7 minutes; they are very cost effective if there are a few of you.
