locationDescriptions.title: Neighborhood highlights
locationDescriptions.content:
For visitors to London, the property is in an exceptional location to enjoy everything the city has to offer. Moments from Hyde Park, walking distance from major attractions including Kensington Palace, Notting Hill Gate, Marble Arch, Portobello Market, Oxford Street and the main museums (the V&A, Natural History, and the Science Museum), there are a panoply of restaurants, shops and modes of transport on your doorstep: 1 minutes walk to Queensway (Central Line), 4-5 minutes to Bayswater (Circle and District Line), and about 8-10 minutes to Notting Hill Gate station (Central, Circle and District). It offers the best of the both worlds as the property is both right at the heart of the city, but quiet and tucked away in a secure private estate.

We have a private Garage.

-Entrance to property - through secure coded gate to private grounds. Enter home through separate gate to first floor terrace. Enter house into open plan reception room, kitchen and dining area and games area.

Off the games area there is access to the boiler room, a laundry room, a double bedroom, and a stairwell that takes you down to an external door leading to a back alley. htmlDescription.htmlText:
Beautiful 2 bedroom 2 bathroom apartment located on the ground floor of a new building. Contemporary style decoration combines charm and purity. Comfortable stay, large screen TV with satellite dish, free Wi-Fi. Equipped kitchen (washing machine, refrigerator, microwave, rice cooker, oven, kitchen utensils) the apartment is in a quiet area, small Odza market 20 minutes from the city center. Secure parking 24 hours a day

We have an on-site restaurant with a regional menu and low prices

The space
The apartment is located in a quiet and safe area, the charm and comfort of the beds is a great asset for a peaceful sleep.
I present all the rooms of the apartment through the photos. If you like chic, comfort and contemporary design, NANDY'S HOME is the ideal place for a quality stay, in complete tranquility.


At NANDY'S HOME you have:

Air conditioning in all rooms

Free Wi-Fi

Plasma cable TV

Hot water in all bathrooms

Washing machine

Stove, piano, oven

Refrigerator

Microwave

Rice cooker

Food processor

Cooking utensils

Cake accessories

Trash can and trash bag

Vacuum cleaner

Iron and ironing board

Bathroom scale

Hangers

Toilet paper, sheets, soaps, hand towels provided

Candles offered for a romantic dinner

Secure parking
Guard 24/7

24/7 SURVEILLANCE CAMERA

Generator

Drilling

Guest access
Taxis

Other things to note
Dear Customers,
*Nandy's HOME* has thought of you by offering you additional equipment: the *Pool*, designed to improve your comfort and well-being.

But for the good hygiene of all, instructions for use must be respected.

Namely:
- Mandatory shower before entering the pool.

- Wearing a swimsuit and a swimming cap is mandatory.

- Need to know how to swim. We are not responsible for accidents or drowning.

- Mandatory accompaniment of minors by an adult who can swim.

- No eating, drinking, smoking, chewing gum, spitting, urinating, running in the water, shouting, loud music or throwing garbage in the pool enclosure. Garbage cans are provided for this purpose.

For the good of all, we ask that you keep the environment clean.

Penalties for non-compliance with the rules.
This can range from temporary exclusion to permanent exclusion.

We ask that you respect these rules and thank you for your understanding.




The Management

htmlDescription.htmlText:
A high-end studio where every detail counts. Design, comfort, technology: everything is designed to transform your stay into an exceptional getaway.

Here, you don't just stay, you have an experience.

Chic, quiet and perfectly equipped, it appeals to discerning travelers looking for much more than just a room.

The art of staying. Let yourself be surprised by the understated elegance of a unique place.

Here, you don't count the hours, you savor them.

The space
🌿 A haven of serenity, where every detail is a thoughtful touch.

La Résidence does not offer just accommodation. It offers you a setting designed for the exceptional: a stay where everything works, where nothing is lacking, where every daily action becomes a pleasure.

📡 Stay connected, have fun
Enjoy a Starlink satellite connection (wired or WiFi) and a Smart TV with access to Tout Canal.

🎁 Small touches that make a difference
Upon arrival, you will find coffee, tea, sugar, mineral water, and snacks (crisps, chips) – enough to settle in without having to plan anything.

✨ Fully equipped, designed for your comfort
Fridge 🧊, microwave, kettle, spacious dressing room, safe, iron. Even laundry detergent and fabric softener – everything is there.

🌳 A garden for rejuvenation
Bench under the trees (boucarou) 🪑, the gentle sound of the two fountains 💧, swing, armchairs... A true haven of peace in the heart of Bonamoussadi.

⚡ Independence with peace of mind
Thanks to the borehole and the generator, you are not dependent on any power outages. Your comfort continues, no matter what.

At La Résidence, Staying differently, Staying as an art. 🏡✨

Guest access
You have the entire room available. The bedroom has its own internal shower. Enjoy with other guests the garden and its patio with two fountains.

Other things to note
The villa is located 50 m from the road and close to Bonamoussadi market, Carrefour Market and various amenities.
